title: Reproducible capillary fluctuation analysis of solid-liquid interfaces for stiffness and anisotropy calculations
summary: The capillary fluctuation method (CFM) is widely used to compute solid--liquid interfacial properties from atomistic simulations, but its accuracy depends on choices in interface construction, wave-vector selection, sampling, and simulation geometry. Here, we develop a diagnostics-driven workflow for reproducible CFM calculations using pure Al as a representative system. Employing both ribbon models and thick two-dimensional references, we show that apparent linearity of the fluctuation spectrum alone does not ensure reliable stiffness or anisotropy estimates. Instead, a reliable CFM analysis requires a fitting window consistent with both temporal sampling and continuum capillary-wave assumptions, systematic sensitivity tests of the interface identification procedure, explicit propagation of replica variability, and independent verification of model-thickness convergence. We further propose a practical thickness-selection rule based on coexistence-temperature consistency, which enables finite-size effects to be controlled while retaining the substantial computational efficiency of ribbon geometries. By making the main sources of uncertainty explicit and diagnosable, the proposed workflow improves the reliability of the CFM as a quantitative tool and provides a foundation for its broader application to complex solid--liquid interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文针对毛细管涨落法(CFM)计算固液界面性质时的不确定性和可重复性问题，以纯铝为模型体系，开发了一套基于诊断的CFM工作流程。通过系统测试界面构建、波矢选择、采样和模拟几何等因素，提出了一套确保CFM结果可靠的诊断准则和实用性厚度选择规则。
AI.motivation: CFM方法虽被广泛用于从原子模拟中计算固液界面性质，但其结果的准确性高度依赖于界面构建、波矢选择、采样策略和模拟几何等多个技术细节。研究中发现，仅凭涨落谱的表观线性并不能保证刚度或各向异性估计的可靠性，需要一套系统化的诊断流程来控制和量化这些不确定性来源。
AI.method: 以纯铝为代表体系，同时采用ribbon模型和厚二维参考进行CFM计算。开发了诊断驱动的工作流程，包括：(1) 拟合窗口需与时间采样和连续毛细波假设同时一致；(2) 对界面识别过程进行系统性敏感度测试；(3) 显式传播副本变异性；(4) 独立验证模型厚度收敛性。并提出基于共存温度一致性的实用厚度选择规则。
AI.result: 证明了涨落谱的表观线性本身不足以确保CFM结果的可靠性；提出了能够控制有限尺寸效应同时保留ribbon几何高效计算优势的厚度选择规则；通过使主要不确定性来源显式化和可诊断化，提高了CFM作为定量工具的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断驱动的工作流程为CFM计算提供了可重复性和可靠性的保障，并为其在更复杂的固液界面体系中的广泛应用奠定了基础。

title: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
summary: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations. A unified interface automatically maps scalar, uniform-basis, and multispecies operators to compressed sparse row (CSR), block sparse row (BSR), or variable-block compressed sparse row (VBCSR). Our advanced acceleration method groups blocks of equal shape and dispatches them to optimized dense kernels. In the reported benchmarks, VBCSR outperforms the tested Python-accessible reference implementations for several block-sparse benchmarks. We further demonstrate VBCSR in an InP nanoparticle application containing more than \(10^6\) atoms.

AI.tldr: VBCSR是一个分布式稀疏矩阵库，保留可变大小的原子块结构，加速大规模原子模拟的核心线性代数运算，在InP纳米颗粒应用中支持超过10^6个原子的模拟。
AI.motivation: 现代原子模拟使用局部化轨道表示量子算子，产生稀疏块矩阵，但块形状随化学物种和基组选择而变化。传统标量稀疏格式逐项存储条目，掩盖了局部块结构，限制了高效块算法的使用。
AI.method: 设计VBCSR库，提供统一接口自动将标量、均匀基组和多物种算子映射到CSR、BSR或VBCSR格式。核心加速方法是将相同形状的块分组，并调度到优化的稠密核上执行。
AI.result: 在多个块稀疏基准测试中，VBCSR性能优于所测试的Python可访问参考实现，并在包含超过10^6个原子的InP纳米颗粒应用中成功演示。
AI.conclusion: VBCSR通过保留可变大小原子块结构并采用块分组优化策略，有效提升了大规模原子模拟中稀疏矩阵运算的效率，展现了在大规模系统模拟中的实用价值。

title: Triboelectrification of a dense metal-organic framework for resilient mechanical energy harvesters
summary: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) incorporating metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) have largely been designed around porous architectures, based on the assumption that high internal surface area is the primary driver for triboelectric enhancement. Herein, we demonstrate that a dense, nominally nonporous MOF called ZIF-zni can instead function as an effective high-loading filler within a tribopositive polyurethane (PU) matrix, offering a design strategy for harnessing interfacial electromechanical effects. A 20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU composite delivers an output voltage of 470+/-15 V and a peak power density of 1.31+/-0.03 W m-2 against polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). The device exhibits stable performance over ~94,000 cycles under a contact force of ~100 N, and it remains operational under higher impact beyond 500 N. This concept enables the demonstration of a proof-of-concept triboelectric floor tile. Combined experimental and theoretical studies indicate that the performance enhancement arises from favourable interfacial polarization, reduced dielectric screening, and surface accessible ZIF-zni rich domains, rather than porosity alone. These features are accompanied by reduced work of adhesion and modified surface roughness, hence improving contact electrification. These findings establish dense MOFs as an effective triboelectric filler and identify interfacial electronic structure and polarization as key design parameters for engineering mechanical energy harvesters and self-powered sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文证明致密无孔MOF（ZIF-zni）可作为摩擦正电聚氨酯（PU）基体中的高效高负载填料，20wt%的ZIF-zni@PU复合材料对PDMS输出电压470V、功率密度1.31W/m²，并在约94,000次循环后保持稳定，为摩擦电能量收集提供了基于界面电极化效应的新设计思路。
AI.motivation: 传统TENG复合MOF填料的设计主要围绕多孔结构展开，认为高比表面积是摩擦电增强的主要驱动力。作者质疑这一假设，探索致密无孔MOF是否也能发挥有效的摩擦电增强作用，从而拓宽MOF填料的设计空间。
AI.method: 选用致密无孔MOF（ZIF-zni）作为填料分散于PU基体中，制备不同负载量的复合材料；结合实验表征与理论计算，系统研究界面极化、介电屏蔽、表面粗糙度及粘附功等对接触起电的影响机制。
AI.result: 20wt% ZIF-zni@PU复合膜对PDMS输出470±15V电压和1.31±0.03W/m²峰值功率密度；在~100N接触力下稳定运行~94,000次循环，并能承受500N以上冲击；性能增强归因于有利的界面极化、降低的介电屏蔽及表面可及的ZIF-zni富集区域，而非单纯孔隙率。
AI.conclusion: 致密MOF同样可成为有效的摩擦电填料，界面电子结构与极化应作为机械能量收集器及自供电传感器工程设计的核心参数，推翻了仅依赖高孔隙率这一传统认知。

title: Calculation of DFT Spin-Orbit Spillage with Quantum ESPRESSO
summary: This work describes the calculation of spin-orbit spillage from a crystal structure. Spin-orbit spillage provides a measure of the likelihood that a material has topological character. The spillage also provides the reference quantity for the machine-learning classifier of Choudhary et al., which predicts whether the spillage exceeds a specified threshold rather than the calculation of its numerical value directly. The complete computation workflow was applied to the insulating compound BaMg2Bi2, yielding a spillage of 2.094 compared with the published VASP spillage of 2.075, corresponding to a difference of 0.9%. The calculation is described in terms of two Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) calculations of spillage performed with and without spin-orbit coupling, the role of relativistic pseudopotentials, and the subsequent wavefunction-overlap analysis. The limitations of the same calculation procedure for semimetals are also examined.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了从晶体结构计算自旋轨道"溢出量"(spin-orbit spillage)的方法，该方法用于衡量材料具有拓扑特性的可能性，并与机器学习分类器相关联。作者将该计算流程应用于绝缘体化合物BaMg2Bi2，得到了与已发表VASP结果相差仅0.9%的溢出量(2.094 vs 2.075)，并讨论了基于Quantum ESPRESSO的两步计算流程的实现细节及其在半金属中的局限。
AI.motivation: 自旋轨道溢出量是判断材料是否具有拓扑特性的重要参考指标，同时也是Choudhary等人机器学习分类器的参考量。然而，该计算流程的具体实现细节（特别是基于Quantum ESPRESSO的实现）缺乏系统描述，且现有计算主要依赖VASP，需要验证QE计算流程的可行性及一致性。
AI.method: 采用两次Quantum ESPRESSO计算：一次考虑自旋轨道耦合，一次不考虑；配合相对论性赝势的使用，随后进行波函数重叠(overlap)分析来计算自旋轨道溢出量。将该方法应用于绝缘体BaMg2Bi2验证其准确性。
AI.result: 对BaMg2Bi2计算得到的自旋轨道溢出量为2.094，与已发表的VASP结果2.075相比，差异仅为0.9%，验证了基于QE的计算流程的有效性。同时，论文考察了该计算流程在半金属材料中应用的限制。
AI.conclusion: 作者提供了一套完整的基于Quantum ESPRESSO的自旋轨道溢出量计算工作流，其结果与VASP高度一致，可作为机器学习拓扑材料预测的可替代或补充工具；但该方法对半金属体系存在局限性，需要进一步改进。

title: Exact quantum spin liquids with topological order on maple-leaf and trellis lattices
summary: We construct spin models with bond-dependent anisotropic interactions on the penta-coordinated maple-leaf and trellis lattices, which yield exact $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quantum spin liquids akin to the Kitaev honeycomb model. We characterize the resulting ground states by their flux sectors, Chern numbers, and topological excitations. Using replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that the gauge fluxes are ordered at sufficiently low temperatures such that every unit triangle has $\pm π/2$-flux, where the sign is uniform across the system, and every unit hexagon (square) has $0$-flux ($π$-flux) within the parameter space of interest. We map out the topological phase diagram for each model, which reveals parameter regimes hosting $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and Ising topological orders, and we derive an analytical expression for the mass term of the Majorana fermions, the vanishing of which indicates a transition between these phases. We further establish the correspondence between individual vortices (i.e., flux excitations) and two species of anyons in the dimer limit, overcoming the obstacle faced by degenerate perturbation theory in treating odd-length elementary plaquettes. Interestingly, we find that two dimer limits of the maple-leaf model with distinct assignments of anyon species can be smoothly connected to each other in the vortex-free sector, but they are separated by fermion-gap-closing transitions in certain two-vortex sectors.

AI.tldr: 该论文在五配位的枫叶晶格和格子晶格上构建了具有键依赖各向异性相互作用的自旋模型，这些模型产生与Kitaev蜂窝模型类似的精确Z₂量子自旋液体。研究者通过通量扇区、陈数和拓扑激发表征基态，并使用副本交换量子蒙特卡罗模拟发现在低温下规范通量有序排列。他们还绘制了拓扑相图，揭示了Z₂和Ising拓扑序的参数区间，并建立了涡旋（通量激发）与任意子之间的对应关系。
AI.motivation: 扩展Kitaev蜂窝模型中精确可解的量子自旋液体到其他几何结构（如五配位的枫叶晶格和格子晶格），并研究其中的拓扑激发、通量序和相位转变。特别需要克服退化微扰论在处理奇数长度基本环（如三角形）时遇到的困难。
AI.method: 1. 在枫叶晶格和格子晶格上构建具有键依赖各向异性相互作用的自旋模型（Kitaev型）。2. 使用精确解来表征Z₂量子自旋液体的基态（通量扇区、陈数、拓扑激发）。3. 采用副本交换量子蒙特卡罗模拟研究低温通量有序行为。4. 推导Majorana费米子质量项的解析表达式以指示相变。5. 在二聚体极限中建立涡旋与两类任意子之间的对应关系。
AI.result: 发现低温下每个单位三角形具有±π/2-通量（符号全系统均匀），单位六边形具有0-通量，单位正方形具有π-通量。绘制了拓扑相图，揭示了Z₂和Ising拓扑序的参数区间。还发现枫叶模型的两个二聚体极限在涡旋自由扇区可以平滑连接，但在某些双涡旋扇区被费米子间隙关闭转变所分隔。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将Kitaev型精确可解量子自旋液体成功推广到五配位晶格，提供了完整的通量物理图景、拓扑相图和任意子激发理解，为探索更丰富的量子自旋液体现象提供了新的理论平台。

title: The influence of quantum geometry on the phase boundary and collective excitations of electron liquids and crystals
summary: Recent experiments on multilayer graphene systems have reinvigorated the study of electron crystallization, now with the inclusion of quantum geometry. In this work, we apply time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF) to the $λ$-jellium model to analyze the impact that quantum geometry has on the electronic liquid--crystal phase diagram and how it modifies the collective modes and responses of the liquid and crystal phases. In agreement with recent results utilizing neural quantum states, we find that quantum geometry favours electron crystallization, shifting the transition to higher densities. We also study the instabilities revealed by TDHF in the Fermi liquid ground state at low densities, providing insight into the fluctuations driving the crystallization transition. We further find that quantum geometry reduces the dispersion of the plasmon mode and suppresses Friedel oscillations deep in the liquid phase. Resolving the density response in terms of individual orbitals, we find that this suppression is caused by spectral weight transfer to an out-of-phase inter-orbital mode. Finally, we show that an analogous mode that emerges in the crystal phase corresponds to the breathing mode of an emergent real-space pseudospin skyrmion lattice.

AI.tldr: 本文用时变Hartree-Fock方法研究λ-jellium模型中量子几何对电子液-晶相图、集体模式及响应的影响，发现量子几何促进电子结晶并使转变向更高密度移动，同时抑制等离激元色散和Friedel振荡。
AI.motivation: 多层石墨烯系统的近期实验重新激发了电子结晶的研究，但多体系统的量子几何效应尚未被充分理解。作者希望系统分析量子几何如何影响电子液-晶相图以及如何修改液态和晶态相的集体模式与响应，以填补该领域理论空白。
AI.method: 采用时变Hartree-Fock (TDHF) 方法应用于λ-jellium模型，分析量子几何对相图的影响，并通过在费米液体基态中探测不稳定性和按轨道分解密度响应来揭示背后的物理机制。
AI.result: 1) 与神经量子态结果一致，量子几何有利于电子结晶并提高转变密度；2) TDHF揭示了低密度费米液体基态的不稳定性，提供结晶转变涨落的信息；3) 量子几何降低等离激元色散并抑制费米液体深处的Friedel振荡，其根源是谱权重转移至异相轨道间模式；4) 晶相中类似模式对应于实空间赝自旋斯格明子晶格的呼吸模式。
AI.conclusion: 量子几何是调控电子液-晶转变和集体激发的重要自由度，其影响不仅体现在静态相图上，还通过独特的谱权重转移机制改变体系的动态响应，并可能为理解晶体相中的拓扑激发提供新视角。

title: Reduced Precision Diffusion Synthetic Acceleration for S$_N$ Neutron Transport in LLNL's ARDRA using Hypre
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, submitted to ANS M&C 2027
summary: Fast solution times in production discrete ordinates transport codes often require the use of diffusion synthetic acceleration (DSA). A good implementation of DSA will substantially reduce the number of iterations to converge the transport solution at the cost of solving a diffusion-like linear system at each iteration. Often fewer transport iterations will lead to smaller times to solution. Recent work has shown the promise of reduced precision preconditioning. Time and memory cost can be decreased as long as the reduced precision does not substantially degrade the convergence behavior of the higher precision linear system being solved. In this paper, we discuss the algorithmic implications of accelerating transport iterations in double precision (64 bit) while using a reduced precision (32 bit) DSA solve. We initially implement a stand alone code to investigate any theoretical limitations of reduced precision DSA in slabs. Then we implement reduced precision DSA in ARDRA, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory's (LLNL) discrete ordinance neutral particle transport code, coupled with {\it hypre}, LLNL's scalable linear solver and multigrid methods library capable of mixed precision linear solves Then we solve various neutron transport problems of interest. We find that in most circumstances, DSA acceleration in reduced precision has little to no impact on the acceleration properties of DSA when used with source iteration in most circumstances. However, as tighter tolerances are required, reduced precision DSA may fail to successfully accelerate the transport solve and increase time to solution.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在离散纵标输运代码中使用降精度（32位）扩散合成加速（DSA）来加速双精度（64位）输运迭代的算法可行性。研究表明，在大多数情况下，降精度DSA对加速性能几乎没有影响，但当需要更严格的收敛容差时，降精度DSA可能无法有效加速输运求解，反而增加求解时间。
AI.motivation: 生产级离散纵标输运代码中，DSA能显著减少输运迭代次数但每次迭代需求解扩散类线性系统。近期工作表明降精度预处理可降低时间和内存成本，但其在DSA中的算法影响尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 首先实现独立代码研究平板几何中降精度DSA的理论限制，然后在LLNL的ARDRA离散纵标中性粒子输运代码中实现降精度DSA，并耦合支持混合精度线性求解的hypre库，最后求解多种中子输运问题。
AI.result: 在大多数情况下，降精度DSA与源迭代结合使用时，对DSA的加速性能影响很小甚至没有影响。但当收敛容差收紧时，降精度DSA可能无法成功加速输运求解，反而导致求解时间增加。
AI.conclusion: 降精度DSA在多数场景下可行且能保持加速性能，但其适用范围受收敛精度需求限制——高精度要求下降精度方案失效。这为混合精度计算在粒子输运模拟中的应用提供了实践指导。

title: Fukui-Kawakami chains: spectrum and hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry
summary:
Fukui and Kawakami showed that the trigonometric Haldane--Shastry (HS) spin chain can be deformed by introducing twisted boundary conditions. In this work we revisit the resulting twisted HS chains, which we call Fukui--Kawakami (FK) chains.
  We analyse their spectra in dependence of the twist parameter, utilising a direct connection with the (untwisted) HS chain. This allows us to explain why part of the spectrum can be described by Fukui and Kawakami's twisted Bethe equations, and can be constructed from Yangian highest weight states. These states can be labelled by combinatorial data called `motifs', as in the HS chain, which cover some of the (deformed) descendants. We furthermore show that there are other descendants which do not follow from these Bethe equations, but whose energy can be described as a sum of two single-particle energies, suggesting additional hidden symmetries.
  We then focus on the special case of antiperiodic boundary conditions, and show that this chain coincides with the `minimally polarised' long-range model recently introduced by Basu-Mallick, Finkel, and González-López. Remarkably, this connection implies that the antiperiodic chain has a hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry, which we use to relate the HS motifs to their `supersymmetric' $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了由Fukui和Kawakami提出的具有扭转变换边界条件的三角函数Haldane–Shastry（HS）自旋链，称之为Fukui–Kawakami（FK）链。作者通过将其与未扭转的HS链建立直接联系来分析其谱结构，解释了为何部分谱可由Fukui–Kawakami扭转变换Bethe方程描述并可从Yangian最高权重态构造。研究发现其他后裔态不遵循这些Bethe方程，但其能量可表示为两个单粒子能量之和，暗示存在额外的隐藏对称性。特别地，反周期边界情形与Basu-Mallick等人提出的"最小极化"长程模型一致，揭示了该链具有隐藏的gl(1|1)对称性，并据此将HS motif与其超对称对应物联系起来。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在深入理解Fukui–Kawakami扭转HS链的谱结构。已有研究表明这类变形链可以通过扭转边界条件获得，但其谱的完整描述、哪些态可由Bethe方程刻画、以及背后隐藏的对称性仍未完全阐明。此外，揭示特定边界条件下链与超对称模型的联系，有助于建立不同可积模型之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 作者采用与未扭转HS链的直接连接来分析FK链的谱，利用Yangian最高权重态结构和'motif'组合标记来分类态。通过Bethe方程的分析区分可描述与不可描述的态，并考察后者的能量结构以推断隐藏对称性。最后集中研究反周期边界条件这一特殊情形，通过与Basu-Mallick等人模型的等价性揭示gl(1|1)超对称结构。
AI.result: （1）阐明了为何部分FK链谱可由扭转Bethe方程描述并可从Yangian最高权重态构造；（2）发现存在不遵循Bethe方程的后裔态，其能量为两个单粒子能量之和，暗示额外隐藏对称性；（3）证明反周期情形与"最小极化"长程模型等价；（4）利用该等价性揭示反周期FK链的隐藏gl(1|1)超对称性，并建立HS motifs与其超对称对应物之间的联系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究系统性地揭示了FK链的谱结构：部分态可由扭转Bethe方程与Yangian最高权重态框架描述，而其他后裔态的存在暗示更丰富的隐藏对称性。反周期边界条件下的等价性不仅建立了FK链与超对称长程模型的联系，还提供了理解这些模型对称性的新视角，为后续探索其他可积变形及超对称结构的研究开辟了方向。

title: Orientation selection and superconducting properties of epitaxial Al on ferromagnetic semiconductor (In,Fe)As
summary: Superconductor/ferromagnet heterostructures provide a versatile platform for exploring spin-dependent superconducting phenomena arising from interfacial proximity effects. In this article, we investigate the structural and superconducting properties of Al thin films grown in situ by molecular beam epitaxy on strained Fe-doped ferromagnetic semiconductor (FMS) (In,Fe)As layers. X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal the epitaxial growth of single-crystalline Al layers, with the growth orientation changing from (110) to (111) as the in-plane lattice constant of (In,Fe)As increases. The superconducting critical temperature of Al varies systematically with the film surface morphology and grain size. In addition, the critical magnetic field of Al exhibits an anomalous decrease below 0.5 K, possibly reflecting magnetic coupling to the underlying FMS (In,Fe)As layer. These findings provide a guideline for material design of epitaxial Al/(In,Fe)As heterostructures, which may serve as a promising platform for investigating proximity-induced superconducting and magnetic phenomena in semiconductor-based hybrid quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在应变Fe掺杂铁磁半导体(In,Fe)As层上通过分子束外延原位生长的Al薄膜的结构和超导性质，发现Al的外延生长取向随(In,Fe)As面内晶格常数变化，超导临界温度受表面形貌和晶粒尺寸影响，且临界磁场在0.5 K以下出现反常减小，可能与底层铁磁层的磁耦合有关。
AI.motivation: 超导体/铁磁体异质结构是探索自旋相关超导现象的重要平台，而基于半导体体系的混合量子器件需要高质量的超导/铁磁半导体外延界面，但目前对这类材料体系的系统性研究仍不充分，缺乏对结构-超导性能关系的深入理解。
AI.method: 在应变Fe掺杂铁磁半导体(In,Fe)As层上通过分子束外延原位生长Al薄膜，利用X射线衍射和透射电子显微镜表征晶体结构和外延取向，并通过测量超导临界温度和临界磁场来评估超导性能随薄膜形貌和晶格条件的变化。
AI.result: 实现了Al在(In,Fe)As上的单晶外延生长，外延取向随(In,Fe)As面内晶格常数从(110)向(111)转变；Al超导临界温度随表面形貌和晶粒尺寸系统变化；临界磁场在0.5 K以下呈现反常下降，暗示与底层(In,Fe)As铁磁层的磁耦合效应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为外延Al/(In,Fe)As异质结构的材料设计提供了指导，这类异质结构有望成为研究半导体基混合量子器件中邻近诱导超导和磁性现象的有前景平台。

title: Three-Electrode TiO2 + rGO Cells: Classical Controls and Interpretation within a Quantum-Discord Framework
comment: 31 pages, 7 figures; Supplementary Material: 9 pages, 4 figures
summary: In three-electrode electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), the impedance/capacitance response of the working electrode (WE) is measured relative to the reference electrode (RE), whereas the current required by potentiostatic control flows between the WE and the counter electrode (CE). Under classical three-electrode operation, the measured WE-RE response should therefore be independent of the properties of the electrode used as the CE, provided that conventional electrochemical and instrumental artifacts are negligible. Here, we test this expectation in cells containing nanostructured electrodes TiO2 + rGO and examine the results within a framework motivated by quantum discord to describe effective interelectrode correlations. We used dummy-cell measurements, a two-electrode bar-bar control, comparisons between Pt and bar CEs, a dummy circuit introduced into the CE branch, and CE ensemble comparisons to distinguish additive circuit behavior from CE-dependent behavior specific to the three-electrode configuration. In these experiments, the measured three-electrode capacitance response depends on CE, an effect that is not reproduced by the dummy-circuit controls examined. These findings identify a macroscopic CE-dependent capacitance response that departs from the tested classical expectation and is compatible with an effective interelectrode-correlation framework motivated by quantum discord, although the capacitance evidence alone does not constitute a direct measurement of quantum discord.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验挑战了三电极电化学阻抗谱（EIS）中工作电极（WE）响应应独立于对电极（CE）性质的经典假设。在含TiO2+rGO纳米结构电极的电池中，研究发现测量的三电极电容响应依赖于CE，且这种依赖无法通过简单的加法电路行为或假电池对照实验来复现。该现象与基于量子失协的有效电极间关联框架相容，但电容证据本身并不构成对量子失协的直接测量。
AI.motivation: 经典三电极EIS理论认为WE-RE测量响应与CE性质无关。作者希望在实验上检验这一预期，特别是在含纳米结构电极（TiO2+rGO）的体系中，并探索是否可能存在超出经典电路描述的电极间关联效应。
AI.method: 采用多种对照实验设计：假电池测量、两电极棒-棒对照、Pt与棒状CE比较、在CE支路中引入假电路、以及CE集合体比较，用以区分加法电路行为与三电极构型特有的CE依赖行为。分析框架上借助量子失协概念构建有效电极间关联模型。
AI.result: 实验结果明确显示三电极电容响应依赖于CE的选择，该效应无法由所检验的假电路对照所复现，表明这不是简单的加法电路伪影，而是三电极构型特有的宏观CE依赖响应。
AI.conclusion: 发现了一种偏离经典预期的宏观CE依赖电容响应，其结果与基于量子失协的有效电极间关联框架相符；但作者强调电容证据本身不足以构成对量子失协的直接测量，需要进一步的工作来验证底层机制。

title: Structural tuning of reduced exciton mass in layered HOIP compounds: Causation vs. correlation
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures. For associated SI information, see DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22261753
summary: Reduced exciton mass ($μ$) was recently reported to correlate strongly with a framework distortion in a series of nine single-layer (2D) metal-halide perovskite (HOIP) compounds. Specifically, $μ$ was observed to increase in tandem with an alternating PbI4 octahedral tilt about an in-plane axis. In this work, we use group representation theory to decompose the observed framework distortions into displacive symmetry modes of a common high-symmetry parent framework. We find that all nine distorted frameworks involve linear combinations of the same six symmetry modes, which have been reported to contribute to the framework distortions of a wide range of HOIP compounds. We show that these modes have highly correlated impacts on the band structure. To differentiate causation from correlation, we vary the amplitude of each mode independently and use density-functional theory to determine the resulting electronic band structures, from which $μ$ is extracted. We find that bond-transverse displacements of the equatorial halide atoms increase $μ$, while bond-transverse displacements of the apical halide atoms decrease it. Bond-axis displacements appear to have little or no effect on $μ$. Our results demonstrate three new structure-property relationships, revealing a promising new avenue for exciton engineering in layered perovskite materials.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用群表示论将九种单层金属卤化物钙钛矿化合物的框架畸变分解为六种对称位移模式，通过独立调节各模式幅度并运用密度泛函理论计算，揭示了降低激子质量（μ）的结构-性质新关系：赤道卤素原子的键横向位移增大μ，顶角卤素原子的键横向位移减小μ，而键轴位移对μ影响甚微。
AI.motivation: 近期研究发现单层金属卤化物钙钛矿的激子质量与框架畸变（特别是PbI4八面体绕面内轴的交替倾斜）强相关，但畸变模式众多且相互耦合，难以区分因果关系与单纯相关性，亟需系统解耦各畸变模式对激子质量的独立贡献。
AI.method: 采用群表示论将观测到的框架畸变分解为共同高对称性母框架的六种位移对称模式；独立改变每种模式的幅度，结合密度泛函理论计算电子能带结构并提取相应的激子质量μ，从而区分因果关系与相关性。
AI.result: 发现所有九种畸变框架均为相同六种对称模式的线性组合；这些模式对能带结构产生高度相关的影响。独立控制幅度后发现：赤道卤素原子的键横向位移增加μ，顶角卤素原子的键横向位移减小μ，键轴方向位移对μ几乎无影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了三条新的结构-性质关系，为层状钙钛矿材料中的激子工程开辟了新的可行途径，对光电材料设计具有重要指导意义。

title: Dual Charge-Density-Waves in Two-dimensional DyTe3 and Their Distinct Impacts on Magneto-Transport Properties
summary: Charge-density-waves (CDWs) are macroscopic quantum states defined by periodic modulations in electronic charge density coupled with lattice distortions. Despite significant research efforts, the evolution of electromagnetic transport properties in the presence of CDWs remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the effects of two orthogonal CDWs (CDW1 and CDW2) coexisting at low-temperature in DyTe3 on its electronic transport properties. Importantly, we find that while no clear magnetotransport anomaly is resolved across CDW1 transition under the present experimental conditions, the emergence of CDW2 drives a drastic enhancement in magnetoresistance and a multiband-governed nonlinear Hall response. These results demonstrate that CDW1 and CDW2 in DyTe3 are fundamentally different and impact its electronic transport in qualitatively distinct ways, establishing DyTe3 as a model system for understanding the transport consequences of multiple CDWs in quasi-two-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了DyTe3材料中两种正交电荷密度波（CDW1和CDW2）共存时对电子输运性质的影响，发现CDW2的出现显著增强了磁阻并诱导出多带主导的非线性霍尔响应，而CDW1则无明显磁输运异常，表明两种CDW在本质上是不同的。
AI.motivation: 尽管CDW是重要的宏观量子态，但CDW存在时光电磁输运性质的演化仍未被充分探索，特别是多种CDW共存时对输运性质的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在低温下对DyTe3中两种正交CDW（CDW1和CDW2）共存的电子输运性质进行系统测量，包括磁电阻和霍尔效应的表征，对比分析不同CDW相变前后的磁输运行为。
AI.result: CDW1相变时在现有实验条件下未观察到明显的磁输运异常，而CDW2的出现导致磁阻大幅增强，并产生由多带效应控制的非线性霍尔响应。
AI.conclusion: DyTe3中的CDW1和CDW2在本质上是不同的，它们对电子输运产生定性上截然不同的影响，使DyTe3成为理解准二维材料中多种CDW输运后果的模型系统。

title: Quantum oscillations of helical edge states of periodically deformed 2D topological insulator in magnetic field
summary: We study edge-state transport in a two-dimensional topological insulator with a periodically deformed edge subjected to a uniform magnetic field. Zeeman coupling breaks time-reversal symmetry and enables elastic backscattering, producing oscillations of the forbidden-band widths. In the strong-field regime, the gaps can close completely at discrete field values. In the weak-field regime, we identify an important class of periodic deformations for which the dominant semiclassical scattering is controlled by complex infinity rather than by the nearest turning points. We develop a semiclassical treatment of this process and establish its agreement with perturbation theory and direct numerical calculations. The gap modulation should produce observable oscillations of the edge conductance. Unlike conventional magnetic quantum oscillations, which are periodic in inverse field, the predicted oscillations are periodic in the magnetic field itself, with a period determined by the Fermi velocity and effective g-factor

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维拓扑绝缘体中周期性变形边界在均匀磁场下的边缘态输运。Zeeman耦合破坏时间反演对称性并引发弹性背散射，导致禁带宽度振荡。强场下带隙可在离散场值处完全闭合；弱场下识别出一类重要周期变形，其主导半经典散射由复无穷远而非最近转折点控制。预测的间隙调制产生边缘电导的可观测振荡，且这些振荡在磁场本身上呈现周期性（而非传统磁量子振荡的反比周期性），周期由费米速度和有效g因子决定。
AI.motivation: 理解二维拓扑绝缘体中受磁场影响的边缘态输运机制，特别是周期性边界变形与Zeeman耦合共同作用下产生的量子振荡现象，并揭示其与传统磁量子振荡的本质区别。
AI.method: 结合半经典散射理论、微扰理论和直接数值计算，研究周期性变形边缘在磁场中的边缘态能谱。特别发展了由复无穷远控制的半经典散射处理方法（区分于传统最近转折点方法），并验证其与微扰理论和数值结果的一致性。
AI.result: （1）Zeeman耦合导致弹性背散射并产生禁带宽度的振荡；（2）强场区带隙可在离散磁场值处完全闭合；（3）弱场区识别出由复无穷远控制的半经典散射机制；（4）推导出的振荡周期性在磁场本身（而非1/B）上呈周期性，周期由费米速度与有效g因子决定。
AI.conclusion: 边缘电导的磁场周期性振荡代表一类不同于传统Shubnikov-de Haas振荡的新现象，其周期性直接依赖于磁场而非反比磁场，为拓扑绝缘体边缘态探测和输运调控提供了新的可观测物理效应。

title: Learning multistate kinetics with a variational multistate committor network
summary: The long-time dynamics of complex molecular systems often involves rare transitions across networks of metastable states. Building on transition-path theory, which provides a rigorous framework for describing rare transitions between two metastable states, we introduce the variational multistate committor network (VMCN), a neural framework that learns the probabilities of reaching each metastable state directly from molecular simulation data. From this representation, VMCN identifies state-specific commitment, candidate transition regions and committor-consistent pathways between state pairs, and an effective kinetic network characterized by transition rates. The model is trained using finite time-lag trajectory data together with boundary conditions defined on conservative state cores. Applications to a triple-well potential, trialanine isomerization, and the $c$--ring rotation in the V$_{\rm o}$ domain of a vacuolar ATPase show that VMCN recovers metastable organization, provides committor-consistent descriptions of transition mechanisms, and estimates state-to-state kinetics. VMCN further provides diagnostics for incomplete state decompositions and enables adaptive exploration of candidate metastable states and their connecting regions. By integrating VMCN with generative committor-guided path sampling (Gen-COMPAS) for chignolin, we start from two end point structures, identify a misfolded state and a candidate folding intermediate, and we direct subsequent sampling toward the resulting multistate transition network.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变分多态committor网络（VMCN），一种直接从分子模拟数据学习到达各亚稳态概率的神经网络框架，用于描述复杂分子系统中的罕见跃迁。VMCN基于过渡路径理论，从表示中识别状态特定的commitment、候选过渡区域、committor一致的路径对以及有效动力学网络。在具体应用中，VMCN与生成式committor引导路径采样（Gen-COMPAS）结合，展示了自适应探索亚稳态和构建多态过渡网络的能力。
AI.motivation: 复杂分子系统的长时间动力学常涉及跨越亚稳态网络的罕见跃迁，而现有方法主要关注两态之间的过渡，缺乏对多态网络的系统描述框架。作者旨在构建一个能够从模拟数据中直接学习多态跃迁行为的神经网络框架。
AI.method: VMCN通过有限时间滞后轨迹数据与定义在保守态核上的边界条件进行训练，学习到达每个亚稳态的概率。从该表示中，可提取状态特定commitment、候选过渡区域、committor一致的路径对及动力学网络。模型还提供状态分解不完整的诊断，并通过与Gen-COMPAS生成式路径采样集成，实现自适应探索。
AI.result: 在三井势、三肽异构化和V-ATPase V_o域c环旋转等应用上，VMCN成功恢复了亚稳态组织，提供了committor一致的过渡机制描述，并估计了态间动力学。在chignolin应用中，从两个端结构出发，识别出错误折叠态和候选折叠中间态，指导后续采样朝向多态过渡网络。
AI.conclusion: VMCN提供了一种通用且可扩展的框架，将多态稀有跃迁的识别、机制描述和动力学估计统一起来，并能够诊断状态分解不足并进行自适应探索，为复杂分子系统的多态动力学分析提供了新范式。

title: Breakdown of the Overdamped Approximation in Fluctuating Environments
summary: The overdamped approximation is widely used to describe Brownian motion in complex environments, but its validity becomes nontrivial when the friction coefficient itself fluctuates in time. We investigate this problem by comparing underdamped and overdamped Langevin dynamics subject to the same fluctuating friction and satisfying the fluctuation--dissipation relation at a common temperature. We show that environmental averaging and inertial elimination generally lead to different long-time transport when environmental fluctuations are fast compared with velocity relaxation. For rapidly fluctuating friction, the underdamped dynamics is governed by the arithmetic mean friction and yields $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm under}=k_{\rm B}T/\langleγ\rangle$, whereas the overdamped dynamics gives $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm over}=k_{\rm B}T\langleγ^{-1}\rangle$. For a two-state Markov friction, we derive the finite-time effective diffusion coefficient exactly and identify the full crossover between these two regimes, controlled by the competition between velocity relaxation and environmental switching. We further establish the fast-fluctuation result for general stationary friction processes and verify it for a continuous log-Ornstein--Uhlenbeck environment, for which the characteristic crossover time can also be determined independently. Our results reveal a noncommutativity between environmental averaging and inertial elimination, establish a timescale-dependent criterion for the validity of overdamped dynamics in temporally heterogeneous environments, and show that rapid environmental fluctuations can enhance, rather than suppress, the consequences of inertia.

AI.tldr: 本文研究摩擦系数随时间波动时，欠阻尼（underdamped）与过阻尼（overdamped）朗之万动力学是否等价的问题。发现环境平均与惯性消除不可交换：快速波动摩擦下，欠阻尼动力学由摩擦的算术平均决定（D=kT/⟨γ⟩），而过阻尼动力学由倒数平均决定（D=kT⟨γ⁻¹⟩），两者结果不同。通过两态马尔可夫摩擦导出精确有限时间有效扩散系数，刻画了两个机制间的完整交叉过渡。
AI.motivation: 过阻尼近似广泛用于描述复杂环境中的布朗运动，但当摩擦系数本身随时间波动时，该近似的有效性变得非平凡。需要厘清在时间非均匀环境中惯性消除与环境平均的先后顺序是否影响长时输运行为。
AI.method: 对比受相同波动摩擦、满足共同温度下涨落-耗散关系的欠阻尼和过阻尼朗之万动力学。对两态马尔可夫摩擦精确推导有限时间有效扩散系数；对一般平稳摩擦过程建立快速波动结果，并在连续log-Ornstein-Uhlenbeck环境中验证。
AI.result: 快速波动摩擦下：欠阻尼有效扩散系数D_eff^under=kBT/⟨γ⟩，过阻尼为D_eff^over=kBT⟨γ⁻¹⟩；两态马尔可夫摩擦下导出精确有限时间扩散系数，识别出由速度弛豫与环境切换竞争控制的两个机制间的完整交叉；快速波动结果推广到一般平稳过程并在log-OU环境中验证。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了环境平均与惯性消除之间的不可交换性，建立了时间异质环境下过阻尼动力学有效性的时间尺度依赖判据，并展示快速环境波动可能增强而非抑制惯性的影响。

title: On the Stability of the Polar Phase of Superfluid 3He in Nematic Aerogels
comment: 10 pages, 1 Appendix, accepted for publication in JETP Letters
summary: We study the stability of the solution corresponding to the polar phase of superfluid 3He in nematic aerogels with respect to perturbations induced by magnetic impurity scattering. We show that when the perturbation simultaneously breaks axial and time-reversal symmetry, the polar-distorted A phase is realized with the highest transition temperature. Within the proposed model of a p-wave scattering potential, which accounts for the effective spin-orbit interaction between the orbital angular momentum of a scattering quasiparticle and the magnetic moment texture of the scatterer, we solve the eigenvalue and eigenvector problem for the Gor'kov self-consistency equation. Finally, we discuss how our results relate to the available experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超流3He在向列气凝胶中极化相溶液在磁性杂质散射扰动下的稳定性，发现当扰动同时破坏轴向和时间反演对称性时，极化畸变A相具有最高转变温度。通过p波散射势模型（考虑了散射准粒子的轨道角动量与散射体磁矩织构之间的有效自旋轨道相互作用），求解了Gor'kov自洽方程的特征值和特征向量问题，并讨论了与实验数据的关联。
AI.motivation: 理解磁性杂质散射对超流3He在向列气凝胶中极化相的稳定性影响，探究何种对称性破坏条件下能够实现具有最高转变温度的极化畸变A相，并解释相关实验观测结果。
AI.method: 采用p波散射势模型，该模型考虑了散射准粒子的轨道角动量与散射体磁矩织构之间的有效自旋轨道相互作用；通过求解Gor'kov自洽方程的特征值和特征向量问题来分析不同对称性破缺下的相稳定性。
AI.result: 当扰动同时破坏轴向和时间反演对称性时，极化畸变A相以最高转变温度被实现。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的模型能够解释磁性杂质散射诱导的对称性破缺如何影响超流3He在向列气凝胶中的相选择，研究结果与现有实验数据相符。

title: Recovering molecules from coarse-grained beads: free-energy-conditioned generative backmapping across chemical space
summary: Transferable coarse-grained (CG) force fields compress chemical space: by aggregating atoms into a reduced set of interaction beads, models such as MARTINI reduce the number of distinguishable compounds by roughly three orders of magnitude, making high-throughput screening of thermodynamic properties tractable across soft matter, with drug--membrane permeability as a well-developed example. The compression is lossy and, so far, one-way: a screen returns a combination of beads, with no established route back to the compounds it stands for. Recovering those compounds--compositional backmapping--is a one-to-many inverse map, distinct from the better-studied conformational problem of rebuilding atomic coordinates from a known mapping. Here we formulate compositional backmapping as conditional graph generation by introducing juniper, a discrete denoising diffusion model over molecular graphs conditioned on the octanol--water partition free energy $ΔG_{\mathrm{W} \mapsto \mathrm{O}}$, the principal driver of MARTINI bead type assignment and hence a proxy for bead identity. Trained on molecules of up to 9 heavy atoms mapped onto one or two beads, juniper generates molecules that are 93\% valid and 92\% unique for two-bead targets, and whose $ΔG_{\mathrm{W} \mapsto \mathrm{O}}$ distributions track the target $ΔG^{\mathrm{CG}}_{\mathrm{W} \mapsto \mathrm{O}}$ linearly ($r^{2} \geq 0.96$), departing only in the hydrophobic and hydrophilic tails. Although the model receives no chemical information beyond a single scalar, the functional groups shift systematically with the imposed free energy, from branched hydrocarbons at the apolar end to amides, imides, and isocyanates at the polar end. A bead combination flagged by a CG screen can therefore be turned into candidate molecules for atomistic study or synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 juniper，一种基于离散去噪扩散模型的组合反映射方法，可将粗粒化（CG）力场中的珠子组合映射回具体化合物分子，实现从 CG 筛选结果到原子级候选分子的逆转换。该方法以辛醇-水分配自由能 ΔG 为条件，生成有效率为 93%、唯一率为 92% 的分子，且生成的 ΔG 分布与目标值呈线性相关（r²≥0.96）。
AI.motivation: 粗粒化力场（如 MARTINI）通过将原子聚合为珠子大幅压缩化学空间（约三个数量级），但这一压缩是有损且单向的——筛选得到珠子组合后，无法反向找回其代表的化合物。现有的"反映射"研究仅关注构象层面（从已知映射重建原子坐标），而"组合反映射"（从珠子组合推断化合物的组成）是一个被忽视的一对多逆映射问题，缺少有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 论文将组合反映射形式化为条件图生成问题。具体而言：(1) 以 MARTINI 珠子类型判定和分配的主要驱动因素——辛醇-水分配自由能 ΔG_W→O 作为视觉条件（作为珠子身份的代理）；(2) 构建 juniper，一种基于分子图的离散去噪扩散模型；(3) 模型在最多含 9 个重原子、映射到 1-2 个珠子的分子上进行训练；(4) 模型仅接收单一标量（目标 ΔG）即可生成分子图序列。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1) 对双珠子目标，juniper 生成的分子有效率为 93%，唯一率为 92%；(2) 生成分子的 ΔG_W→O 分布与目标 ΔG^CG_W→O 呈线性相关（r²≥0.96），仅在疏水端和亲水端尾部出现偏差；(3) 尽管模型仅接收单一标量作为化学信息输入，生成的官能团随施加的自由能系统性变化——从非极性端的支链烃到极性端的酰胺、酰亚胺和异氰酸酯；(4) 这证明 CG 筛选标记的珠子组合可以被转化为可供原子级研究或合成的候选分子。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了粗粒化模拟工作流中的一个关键空白：实现了从 CG 珠子组合到具体化合物的逆向映射。juniper 通过将化学直觉（分配自由能决定珠子身份）与生成模型结合，使 CG 高通量筛选结果能够直接对接原子级研究和合成验证，为药物-膜渗透性等应用提供一个完整的"正向筛选-反向回映射"闭环工具。

title: Metallic Organometallic and Semiconducting Covalent Phases of Free-Standing $γ$-Graphdiyne Molecular Wires
summary: One-dimensional carbon allotropes combining sp and sp2 hybridizations provide a versatile platform for atomically precise quantum wires with tunable electronic, vibrational, and mechanical responses. Recent on-surface synthesis has realized the $γ$-graphdiyne molecular wire on Au(100) in two interconvertible phases sharing an identical aromatic backbone but distinct linkage chemistry: an organometallic intermediate with C-Au-C bridges and a fully covalent product with diacetylenic linkages. While experimental techniques characterize the on-surface periodicity and C$\equiv$C Raman signatures, the intrinsic properties of the free-standing wires remain inaccessible. Here, we address this gap using hybrid-functional first-principles calculations. The covalent phase is a semiconductor with a direct band gap of 2.02 eV, a polyynic bond-length alternation of 0.117 Å, and a chain periodicity reproducing experiment within -0.5%. Conversely, the organometallic phase exhibits partial cumulenization and 1D metallic behavior, with spin channels crossing the Fermi level. Both isolated polymers demonstrate dynamic stability with Young's moduli of 995 nN and 861 nN, respectively, where the C-Au-C bridge acts as a soft link absorbing 9.2% of axial deformation at +6% macroscopic strain. Species-resolved vibrational analysis identifies an effective-conjugation-coordinate band at 1408 cm$^{-1}$ for the covalent phase and Au-projected modes below 400 cm$^{-1}$ for the intermediate, offering diagnostic fingerprints for phase discrimination during thermal or chemical conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文通过杂化泛函第一性原理计算，系统地研究了γ-石墨二炔分子线的两种可互变相（共价相与有机金属中间相）的自由态本征性质。共价相是直接带隙2.02 eV的半导体，呈现聚炔型键长交替；而有机金属相呈现部分累积烯化和一维金属行为。两者均具有动力学稳定性，杨氏模量分别为995 nN和861 nN，并提出了可用于相辨别的特征振动指纹。
AI.motivation: 尽管实验上表面合成已成功制备出γ-石墨二炔分子线的两种可互变相（有机金属中间相与共价产物），实验技术仅能表征表面周期性和C≡C拉曼特征，无法触及自由态分子线的本征性质，这一关键空白亟需理论计算来填补。
AI.method: 采用杂化泛函第一性原理计算方法，对共价相和有机金属相的γ-石墨二炔自由态分子线进行电子结构、几何结构、力学性质和振动谱的系统计算分析。
AI.result: 共价相为直接带隙2.02 eV的半导体，聚炔型键长交替为0.117 Å，链周期性再现实验误差在-0.5%以内；有机金属相呈部分累积烯化及一维金属行为，自旋通道穿越费米能级。两种聚合物的杨氏模量分别为995 nN和861 nN，C-Au-C桥作为软连接在+6%宏观应变下吸收9.2%的轴向形变。振动分析确定了共价相1408 cm⁻¹的有效共轭坐标带和有机金属相400 cm⁻¹以下的Au投影模式。
AI.conclusion: 理论计算揭示了两种相的本征电子与机械性质的显著差异，并提供了用于热或化学转化过程中相辨别的诊断性振动指纹，为原子级精确量子线的设计与表征提供了理论指导。

title: Layer Architecture Shapes Electronic, Magnetic, and Lattice Interactions in Ruddlesden-Popper Nickelates
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, not including references and additional material
summary: The discovery of superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates has raised a central question: how does layer architecture shape the electronic, magnetic, and lattice interactions relevant to pairing? Here, we report a detailed comparative study of the two polymorphs of La3Ni2O7--the alternating monolayer-trilayer (LNO-1313) and bilayer (LNO-2222) structures--and the related trilayer compound La4Ni3O10, using both Ni L3- and O K-edge RIXS. We find that LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 share strikingly similar electronic, magnetic, and lattice excitations, whereas bilayer LNO-2222 exhibits distinct features. Compared to LNO-2222, LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 have weaker orbital polarization, enhanced 3d8L character, a reduced out-of-plane magnetic-exchange scale, and stronger EPC. Within an effective local-moment framework, an entangled-dimer scenario provides a natural description of the spin excitations generated by strong antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling. Its advantage over conventional spin-wave theory is clearest in bilayer LNO-2222, where the interlayer coupling dominates the intralayer interactions. These findings provide critical experimental constraints for future theoretical models for the low-energy physics relevant to superconductivity in these layered nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Ni L3-和O K-edge RIXS研究了La3Ni2O7的两种多晶型（LNO-1313和LNO-2222）及La4Ni3O10，发现LNO-1313与La4Ni3O10具有相似的电子、磁性和晶格激发，而双层LNO-2222则表现出截然不同的特征。相干二聚体（entangled-dimer）模型能更自然地描述强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发。
AI.motivation: 在Ruddlesden-Popper镍氧化物中发现超导性后，核心问题在于层状架构如何影响与配对所相关的电子、磁性和晶格相互作用。理解不同层结构（单层-三层交替、双层、三层）对其低能物理性质的影响是理解超导机制的关键。
AI.method: 采用共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）技术，分别利用Ni L3边和O K边，对三种化合物——La3Ni2O7的交替单层-三层构型（LNO-1313）、双层构型（LNO-2222）以及三层化合物La4Ni3O10——进行系统的比较研究。通过分析轨道极化、3d8L特征、面外磁交换能和电子-声子耦合（EPC）等参数，并采用有效局域矩框架下的相干二聚体模型描述自旋激发。
AI.result: 研究发现LNO-1313与La4Ni3O10具有高度相似的电子、磁性和晶格激发谱，而LNO-2222则呈现不同特征。与LNO-2222相比，LNO-1313和La4Ni3O10具有更弱的轨道极化、更强的3d8L特征、更小的面外磁交换能标以及更强的电子-声子耦合。相干二聚体模型在描述强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发方面优于传统自旋波理论，尤其在LNO-2222中优势最为明显，因为其层间耦合主导了层内相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为未来理论模型提供了关键的实验约束，有助于理解这些层状镍氧化物中与超导相关的低能物理机制。

title: Evidence of Crystal-Field-Mediated Anisotropic Orbital Rashba Effect in Epitaxial Ru/FM Heterostructure
summary: Electrical generation of orbital angular momentum provides a promising route to current-induced torques, yet effective control of orbital Rashba textures still remains challenging, particularly because the role of the interfacial crystal field remains largely unexplored. Here, we report experimental evidence for a crystal-field-mediated interfacial anisotropic orbital Rashba effect (AORE) in epitaxial Ru/ferromagnet heterostructures. Total orbital torque was disentangled into an isotropic bulk contribution and an in-plane anisotropic interfacial contribution. The latter was strongly suppressed by degrading the crystallinity of either constituent and by inserting a Cu spacer, highlighting the essential roles of coherent interfacial orbital hybridization and direct Ru/ferromagnet contact. These results identify interfacial crystal-field coherency as a key ingredient in manipulating orbital Rashba textures and establish a route toward engineering the symmetry and directionality of orbital torques.

AI.tldr: 该研究在Ru/铁磁异质结中首次实验证实了由界面晶场介导的各向异性轨道Rashba效应（AORE），将总轨道力矩分解为各向同性的体相贡献和面内各向异性的界面贡献，并通过改变结晶度与插入Cu间隔层的对照实验揭示了相干界面轨道杂化和直接接触的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 电学产生轨道角动量被视为实现电流诱导力矩的可行途径，但有效调控轨道Rashba织构仍具挑战性，尤其界面晶场的作用此前几乎未被探索，这阻碍了对轨道力矩对称性和方向性的工程化控制。
AI.method: 在外延生长的Ru/铁磁异质结中开展实验测量，将总轨道力矩分解为各向同性体相贡献与面内各向异性界面贡献；通过降低任一组成层的结晶度以及插入Cu间隔层的对照实验，系统验证界面轨道杂化与直接接触的必要性。
AI.result: 实验观察到界面贡献呈面内各向异性特征，且该各向异性贡献在结晶度退化及插入Cu间隔层后被显著抑制，证实了界面晶场相干性与Ru/铁磁直接接触对AORE的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 界面晶场相干性是调控轨道Rashba织构的关键要素，为工程化设计轨道力矩的对称性与方向性提供了新的技术路线。

title: Learning Memory-Dependent Neural Network Correlation Potentials for Accurate Electron Dynamics
summary: Time-dependent density functional theory, though exact in theory, is in practice applied in an adiabatic approximation using exchange-correlation functionals with only local temporal dependence. Simultaneously, the exact correlation potential formally depends on, among other quantities, the time-history of electron densities. Here we develop a framework to learn neural network models of correlation functionals that feature explicit memory-dependence. Our framework includes two different approaches, both linked through their use of adjoint-based optimization. One approach decouples the learning of the functional from inversion to find ground truth values of the correlation potential. The other approach learns the functional directly without requiring inversion. We apply these methods to modeling the electron dynamics of two-electron systems in two spatial dimensions. In both cases, our methods yield correlation functionals with low test set propagation error, outperforming standard local density and generalized gradient approximation functionals by one to two orders of magnitude. Overall, our framework points at one strategy to move beyond the adiabatic approximation and develop memory-dependent correlation functionals that yield accurate propagation for excited state and/or non-equilibrium dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个利用神经网络学习具有显式记忆依赖的关联泛函框架，用于超越含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）中的绝热近似。框架包含两种基于伴随优化的方法：一种解耦泛函学习与反演，另一种直接学习泛函而无需反演。在二维两电子系统上验证，所提方法比标准LDA和GGA泛函的测试集传播误差低1-2个数量级。
AI.motivation: 严格的含时密度泛函理论要求关联势函数依赖电子密度的时间历史，但实际应用中普遍采用绝热近似，仅使用局域时间依赖的交换关联泛函。这种近似无法准确描述激发态和/或非平衡动力学过程，因此需要发展具有显式记忆依赖的关联泛函。
AI.method: 提出一个基于伴随优化（adjoint-based optimization）的框架来训练具有记忆依赖的神经网络关联泛函。框架包含两种方法：(1) 解耦方法——将泛函学习从反演中解耦，先通过反演获取关联势的真值，再学习泛函；(2) 直接方法——无需反演，直接端到端学习泛函。
AI.result: 在二维两电子系统的电子动力学建模中，两种方法均得到低测试集传播误差的记忆依赖关联泛函，比标准局域密度近似（LDA）和广义梯度近似（GGA）泛函的误差低1-2个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为超越绝热近似提供了一种可行策略，能够发展出记忆依赖的关联泛函，从而在激发态和/或非平衡动力学中获得精确的传播结果。

title: Mean-field theory for quantum spin chains
summary: Mean-field theory is a widely used approximation for describing phase transitions, particularly effective above the upper critical dimension. Its origins can be traced back to the van der Waals theory of the liquid-gas transition and Weiss's molecular field theory of the paramagnetic-ferromagnetic transition. However, it was Lev D. Landau who provided a unifying and general framework applicable to a broad class of physical systems. The mean-field approach typically involves neglecting thermal fluctuations, which is a reasonable assumption in many classical contexts. However, its application to quantum phase transitions at zero temperature is less common. The aim of this short pedagogical paper is to explore and clarify the use of the mean-field approach in the less familiar domain of quantum phase transitions. We specifically consider the Ising model and the Blume-Capel model.

AI.tldr: 这篇教学性短文探讨了平均场理论在量子相变（零温）中的应用，具体以伊辛模型和Blume-Capel模型为例，旨在澄清这一在量子领域较少被使用的近似方法。
AI.motivation: 平均场理论在经典相变中已被广泛应用和深入理解，但其在零温量子相变中的应用相对较少且不常见。作者希望通过这篇教学论文，探索并厘清平均场方法在量子相变这一较不熟悉领域的适用性和具体操作方式。
AI.method: 作者采用教学性论述方式，回顾平均场理论从范德瓦尔斯理论、Weiss分子场理论到Landau统一框架的历史演进，然后将平均场近似应用于量子相变，具体研究对象为伊辛模型和Blume-Capel模型。
AI.result: 文章澄清了在零温量子相变背景下使用平均场近似的方式，并以伊辛模型和Blume-Capel模型作为具体示例加以说明。
AI.conclusion: 平均场方法可以被推广用于分析量子相变，文中通过具体模型演示了其应用过程，为量子相变领域的教学和研究提供了参考框架。

title: Transparency-engineered SQUID cells for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials
summary: We introduce a transparency-engineered rf-SQUID cell for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials. This design replaces the conventional tunnel-junction element with an effective Josephson element formed by two junctions in series, yielding a non-sinusoidal energy-phase relation that can be used as a tunable nonlinear design resource. We show that the asymmetry between the two series junctions and the applied flux bias provide independent control over the local expansion of the rf-SQUID potential, enabling operating points where the leading quartic Kerr term is suppressed while the cubic nonlinearity remains finite. We derive the corresponding Kerr-free condition, identify the resulting operating ridge in parameter space, and analyze the local stability and passive-matching constraints that bound its physically accessible portion. Our results provide a compact unit-cell design principle for three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials and suggest a route toward Kerr-suppressed Josephson traveling-wave parametric amplifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种透明化工程的rf-SQUID单元，用于无Kerr效应的三波混频约瑟夫森超材料。该设计用两个串联约瑟夫森结替代传统隧道结元件，产生非正弦的能量-相位关系，可作为一种可调的非线性设计资源。研究表明，两个串联结的不对称性和外加磁通偏置可独立控制rf-SQUID势能的局域展开，从而实现抑制四阶Kerr项同时保持三阶非线性有限的运行点。
AI.motivation: 传统约瑟夫森行波参量放大器中固有的Kerr（四阶）非线性会导致增益饱和和信号失真，限制其性能。作者希望通过设计新的单元结构来抑制Kerr非线性，同时保留三阶非线性以进行三波混频，从而改进行波参量放大器的质量。
AI.method: 采用双结串联的rf-SQUID单元设计，利用两个串联结的固有不对称性结合外加磁通偏置，对rf-SQUID势能进行局部展开控制。推导了无Kerr条件，识别参数空间中的运行脊线（operating ridge），并分析局部稳定性与被动匹配约束对物理可实现参数范围的限制。
AI.result: 获得了无Kerr运行条件及其对应的参数空间运行脊线，证明该设计可在保持有限三阶非线性（三次混频所需）的同时有效抑制前导四阶Kerr项，并确定了受稳定性和被动匹配约束限制的可访问参数范围。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种紧凑的单胞设计原则，用于三波混频约瑟夫森超材料，为实现Kerr抑制的约瑟夫森行波参量放大器开辟了途径，有望减少增益饱和并提升放大器动态范围。

title: Initialization-free ultralow-power programmable spin-orbit torque logic devices enabled by chirally asymmetric switching
summary: Spin logic is of great interest for the development of high-performance, non-Von Neumann artificial intelligence chips. Of particular advantage is the programmable spin-orbit torque logic that can achieve the complete set of the 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device in an initialization-free, low-power, and scalable manner, which is, however, a challenge despite remarkable efforts over more than two decades. Here, utilizing chirally asymmetric switching, we demonstrate an initialization-free, low-power, programmable spin-orbit torque logic device that is capable of the complete set of 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device with only three inputs and ultralow power of < 1 fJ/bit. We also propose the first initialization-free, all-electrical spin-based cascading computing devices, including a half adder, a three-level full adder, a two-level full adder, and a Transfer/NOT selector. These compact and scalable computing devices are enabled by the chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching of a Ta/FeCoB bilayer with a significant perpendicular Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction field. These results pave an intriguing way for the development of next-generation high-performance large-scale in-memory computing chips based on chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching.

AI.tldr: 本文利用手性不对称自旋轨道矩(SOT)开关，在单个Ta/FeCoB双层器件中实现了无需初始化、超低功耗(<1 fJ/bit)、可编程的完整16种布尔逻辑运算，并首次提出全电学、无需初始化的自旋级联计算器件（半加器、全加器等），为下一代大规模存内计算芯片开辟了新路径。
AI.motivation: 自旋逻辑对开发高性能、非冯·诺依曼人工智能芯片具有重要意义，尽管可编程自旋轨道矩逻辑已被提出，但能够在单一器件中实现完整16种布尔运算、且无需初始化、低功耗、可扩展的方案，经过二十余年努力仍是巨大挑战。
AI.method: 利用手性不对称开关效应，基于具有显著垂直Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用(DMI)场的Ta/FeCoB双层结构，通过仅三个输入端实现单器件内16种完整布尔逻辑运算；并进一步构建级联计算器件，包括半加器、三级全加器、两级全加器及Transfer/NOT选择器。
AI.result: 在单个器件中实现了完整16种布尔逻辑运算，功耗低于1 fJ/bit，且无需初始化；提出了首个无需初始化、全电学的自旋级联计算器件（半加器与各级全加器等），这些器件紧凑且可扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了基于手性不对称自旋轨道矩开关实现高性能大规模存内计算芯片的可行性，为下一代高能效、非冯·诺依曼计算架构铺平了道路。

title: Environment-assisted transport in a strongly correlated boundary-driven Fermi-Hubbard chain
summary: We study steady-state transport in a one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard chain coupled to particle reservoirs at the boundaries and to local dephasing baths at each site, using the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) method to solve the Lindblad master equation. In the absence of dephasing, the current exhibits two well-separated maxima as a function of the boundary driving rate, reflecting the distinct charge and spin energy scales of the strongly correlated regime. Upon introducing dephasing, we find two distinct dephasing-induced transport-enhancement regimes, in contrast to the single enhancement previously reported for spinless fermions. Analysis of the non-equilibrium steady state in the Hamiltonian eigenbasis reveals that the two regimes originate from distinct dephasing-induced redistribution processes: the first involves redistribution within the uppermost Hubbard band, while the second involves transitions between Hubbard bands. Our results demonstrate how many-body correlations shape the interplay between coherent driving, dephasing, and quantum Zeno physics in strongly correlated open systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用TEBD方法求解Lindblad主方程，研究了一维Fermi-Hubbard链在边界粒子库和局域退相干浴作用下的稳态输运性质。发现无退相干时电流呈现两个分离的极大值，反映强关联区电荷与自旋能标；引入退相干后出现两种不同的退相干诱导输运增强机制，分别源于Hubbard带内重分布与带间跃迁，展示了多体关联如何塑造相干驱动、退相干与量子Zeno物理之间的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 理解强关联开放量子系统中多体关联与退相干、相干驱动相互作用的机制，特别是澄清此前基于无自旋费米子研究遗漏的输运增强机制差异。
AI.method: 采用时间演化块消减（TEBD）方法求解Lindblad主方程，研究一维Fermi-Hubbard链在边界粒子库驱动与局域退相干浴作用下的稳态输运；通过对稳态在哈密顿量本征基下进行分析，揭示退相干引起的粒子重分布过程。
AI.result: 无退相干时电流随边界驱动率呈现两个分离的极大值，对应强关联区的电荷与自旋能标；引入退相干后观察到两种独特的退相干诱导输运增强区域，第一种源于最上层Hubbard带内的粒子重分布，第二种源于Hubbard带间的跃迁。
AI.conclusion: 多体关联显著影响退相干与量子Zeno效应在开放系统中的输运表现，Fermi-Hubbard系统的电荷-自旋分离导致比无自旋费米子系统更丰富的退相干增强输运行为。

title: Interlayer Exciton Condensate Stiffness Is Non-Monotonic in Quantum Metric
summary: Identifying the origin of the superfluid stiffness of electron-electron and electron-hole pair condensates is an important issue in flat-band physics. Here, we study the stiffness of bilayer exciton condensates using exact diagonalization and realistic Coulomb interactions across a wide variety of flat Chern band systems, including Landau levels, mixed Landau levels, and moiré bands. We find that stiffness is non-monotonic in the trace of the quantum metric and that it develops peaks when the band wavefunctions are engineered to be similar to those of Landau levels. The stiffness predicted by mean-field theory agrees quantitatively with exact diagonalization in these optimal cases, but systematically overestimates it otherwise. Flat bands with identical quantum geometry tensors can exhibit substantial differences in stiffness. The stiffness of condensates formed between moiré flat bands, which typically have strong variations in Berry curvature and quantum metric across their Brillouin zones, tends to be larger when the bands have non-zero Chern numbers and can be larger than that of Landau levels. Our results reveal a behavior that is richer than that suggested by simple geometric bounds and provide new guiding principles for the design of robust flat-band condensates with large superfluid stiffness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过精确对角化和真实库仑相互作用，研究了平带Chern带系统中双层激子凝聚体的超流刚度，发现其刚度与量子度量迹呈非单调关系，并受能带波函数与朗道能级相似度、陈数及量子几何分布等因素影响。
AI.motivation: 理解电子-电子和电子-空穴对凝聚体的超流刚度起源是平带物理中的重要问题，简单的几何界限可能不足以描述其丰富行为，需要更细致的刻画。
AI.method: 采用精确对角化方法，结合真实库仑相互作用，对涵盖朗道能级、混合朗道能级和莫尔能带等多种平带Chern带系统的双层激子凝聚体刚度进行计算，并与平均场理论结果进行对比。
AI.result: 刚度随量子度量迹呈非单调变化，在波函数接近朗道能级时出现峰值；平均场理论在最优情形与精确对角化一致，但其他情形系统性高估；具有相同量子几何张量的平带刚度可显著不同；莫尔平带中具有非零陈数的带间凝聚刚度往往更大，甚至可超过朗道能级。
AI.conclusion: 平带凝聚体的超流刚度行为比简单几何界限所暗示的更加丰富，研究结果为设计具有大超流刚度的稳健平带凝聚体提供了新的指导原则。

title: Voltage-embedded equivariant machine learning potential for open system simulations
summary: Modeling electrochemical interfaces under operational non-equilibrium conditions is vital for energy technologies but remains bottlenecked by the expensive cost of ab initio methods. Current machine learning potentials, largely designed for closed systems under homogeneous electric fields, are limited in open quantum transport applications. To overcome this, we present an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that embeds voltage bias for open-system simulations. Our approach decouples the system energy and forces into zero-bias and bias-dependent contributions, assigning distinct vector encodings to electrode and scattering-region atoms to capture non-equilibrium conditions. Trained on limited discrete bias data, the model achieves high predictive accuracy and robust extrapolation transferability. When applied to a lithium/water interface, our model successfully captures the field-induced dynamic reorientation of water molecules and reproduces asymmetric electrochemical behavior at different electrodes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种E(3)等变图神经网络，通过将电压偏压嵌入到开放量子输运模拟中，将体系能量和力解耦为零偏压和偏压依赖两部分，实现了对非平衡电化学界面的高效建模，并在锂/水界面中成功捕捉了水分子场致动态重取向及非对称电化学行为。
AI.motivation: 对电化学界面进行非平衡条件下的建模对能源技术至关重要，但从头算方法成本过高，而现有的机器学习势主要针对均匀电场下的闭式系统，难以适用于开放量子输运场景。
AI.method: 构建了一个E(3)等变图神经网络，将电压偏压作为嵌入信息；将体系能量和力解耦为零偏压和偏压依赖两个贡献；对电极原子和散射区原子赋予不同的矢量编码以捕捉非平衡条件；在有限的离散偏压数据上训练。
AI.result: 模型在有限离散偏压数据训练下实现了高预测精度和鲁棒的外推迁移能力；在锂/水界面应用中成功捕捉了场诱导的水分子动态重取向，并复现了不同电极上的非对称电化学行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明基于等变图神经网络并嵌入电压偏压的策略可以有效克服非平衡电化学界面建模的计算瓶颈，为开放量子输运体系下的机器学习势应用提供了新途径。

title: Scaling laws and energy dissipation in the dynamics of SLE curve as a 1D turbulence model
summary: In this study, we demonstrate the characteristics of the stochastic Loewner evolution (SLE) as a one-dimensional (1D) turbulence model. First, we show that the diffusion process $x(t)$ obtained by the time coordinate change in the SLE becomes the time dependent diffusion process that satisfies Richardson's law of turbulence.Subsequently, we derive the condition on the diffusivity parameter $κ$ such that the diffusion process $x(t)$ satisfies Kolmogorov's 4/5th law, which determines the relation between the mean energy dissipation and velocity in the particles of turbulence. Further mathematical analysis showed that this condition is seen as the condition on Loewner entropy $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$, which includes the white Gaussian noise term $W_{s}$ in the Loewner driving function of the present model. In addition, the numerical simulations were performed to verify the scaling relations of this 1D turbulence model. These results suggest that the standard SLE becomes a beneficial model of 1D turbulence by introducing an appropriate time coordinate change and imposing the conditions on $κ$ and $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$.

AI.tldr: 本研究展示了随机Loewner演化(SLE)作为一维湍流模型的特征。通过时间坐标变换得到的扩散过程满足Richardson湍流定律，并推导了扩散系数κ的条件使其满足Kolmogorov的4/5定律。该条件与Loewner熵S_Loew相关，并通过数值模拟验证了标度关系。
AI.motivation: 探索SLE是否可以作为一维湍流的有效数学模型，将通过时间坐标变换的SLE扩散过程与经典湍流定律（Richardson定律和Kolmogorov 4/5定律）建立联系。
AI.method: 1. 对SLE进行时间坐标变换得到扩散过程x(t)；2. 推导扩散系数κ的条件使其满足Kolmogorov 4/5定律；3. 将κ条件转化为对Loewner熵S_Loew（包含白高斯噪声项W_s）的条件；4. 通过数值模拟验证该一维湍流模型的标度关系。
AI.result: 证明了时间坐标变换后的SLE扩散过程满足Richardson定律；推导出使扩散过程满足Kolmogorov 4/5定律的κ条件，该条件等价于对Loewner熵S_Loew的约束；数值模拟验证了标度关系。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入适当的时间坐标变换并对κ和S_Loew施加条件，标准SLE可以成为一种有效的一维湍流模型。
