AI.conclusion: ANT.UI通过图形界面自动化分子结几何构建，加速了理论分子电子学研究并降低了使用门槛，且具备良好的互操作性。

title: Markov chains at the onset of non-reversibility
summary: For a one-dimensional path graph and a lifted path graph constructed from a duplication of each of its sites, we study how a reversible Markov chain can be perturbed and gradually driven into non-reversibility. The reversible Markov chain has a transition matrix that is diagonalizable and features real-valued eigenvalues and eigenvectors. The left and right eigenvectors form a biorthogonal system. We discuss in concrete examples how the transition matrix of a non-reversible Markov chain may be diagonalizable or non-diagonalizable, and it may have real eigenvalues and complex-conjugate pairs. For a number of steady states (flat, square-wave, wedge, V-shape), we compute eigenvalue spectra on both graphs and discuss the speedup that can be achieved through lifting. We develop a Green's matrix formalism, which we use to compute Kemeny times and mean first-passage times, and which provides valuable information and allows us to interpret the results for the characteristic times.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维路径图及其"提升"（lifting）路径图上的可逆马尔可夫链如何被扰动并逐步推向非可逆性。通过具体实例讨论非可逆转移矩阵的可对角化性、实特征值与复共轭对，计算多种稳态下的特征值谱，并发展Green矩阵形式体系来计算Kemeny时间和平均首达时间。
AI.motivation: 理解可逆马尔可夫链在扰动下转向非可逆性的过程，以及提升（lifting）技术如何加速马尔可夫链的收敛，这对于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法和随机算法设计具有重要意义。
AI.method: 从可逆马尔可夫链出发（其转移矩阵可对角化，具有实特征值和双正交的左右特征向量系统），系统地扰动系统使其变为非可逆。在一维路径图和提升路径图（每个位点重复构造）上，针对多种稳态（平坦、方波、楔形、V形）计算特征值谱，并发展Green矩阵形式体系用于计算Kemeny时间和平均首达时间。
AI.result: 通过具体算例展示了非可逆马尔可夫链的转移矩阵可能可对角化或不可对角化，可能具有实特征值也可能具有复共轭对。利用Green矩阵形式体系成功计算了特征时间，并讨论了提升在加速方面所能实现的改进。
AI.conclusion: Green矩阵形式体系为分析提升马尔可夫链的特征时间提供了有力工具，有助于理解和量化提升带来的加速效果以及可逆性破缺对动力学的影响。

title: Multi-task deep-learning optimization of trade-off properties for superior-performance Fe-based soft magnetic alloys
comment: 92 pages, 8 main-text figures, 1 main-text table; Supplementary Materials included
summary: Fe-based amorphous alloys are promising soft magnetic materials for developing next-generation devices with high frequency and efficiency. However, optimization of Fe-based alloys with ultra-high saturation magnetic flux density (B_s), ultra-low coercivity (H_c), and good glass-forming ability is a notorious problem, owing to the vast composition space and complex trade-offs of these properties. Thus, conventional design methods encounter great challenges. Here we develop a generative multi-task deep learning (GMTDL) to achieve simultaneous optimization of compositions and trade-off properties. The GMTDL can sufficiently exploit and share the knowledge of datasets across different tasks, despite the limitation and imbalance of these datasets. Therefore, it exhibits superior performance in prediction of alloys with multiple targeted properties, outperforming previous machine learning-based design strategies. Moreover, the GMTDL can also tailor compositions, providing an efficient way to regulate properties and generate desired candidates for further experimental processing. The validity and reliability of GMTDL are rigorously tested by benchmarking with Fe-based alloys reported very recently. Moreover, some new alloys with ultra-high B_s and ultra-low H_c are predicted. The optimal content windows of key elements and their synergistic effects are also unraveled for practical guidance. Thus, our study establishes an effective and reliable paradigm for simultaneous prediction and optimization of high-performance materials with multiple properties.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种生成式多任务深度学习模型（GMTDL），用于同时优化Fe基非晶合金的成分与多个相互制约的性能（高饱和磁感应强度B_s、低矫顽力H_c和良好非晶形成能力），突破了传统设计与单一任务机器学习方法的局限。
AI.motivation: Fe基非晶合金是高频高效率器件中的关键软磁材料，但成分空间巨大且各性能之间存在复杂的权衡关系（超高B_s、超低H_c与良好玻璃形成能力相互制约），传统设计方法难以同时优化多个目标性能，亟需更高效的多目标优化策略。
AI.method: 提出生成式多任务深度学习（GMTDL）框架：（1）利用多任务学习实现不同任务间知识共享与迁移，克服数据集有限和不平衡的挑战；（2）结合生成式模型实现成分的定制化设计，不仅可预测性能，还能主动生成满足目标性能的新合金成分候选；（3）通过最新报道的Fe基合金进行基准验证，并分析关键元素的最佳含量窗口及其协同效应。
AI.result: GMTDL在预测具有多重目标性能的合金方面优于以往基于机器学习的设计策略；通过近期文献报道的Fe基合金验证了模型的可靠性和有效性；成功预测了数种兼具超高B_s和超低H_c的新型合金，并揭示了关键元素的最优含量范围及其协同作用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一个有效且可靠的同时预测和优化多性能高性能材料的设计范式，为Fe基非晶合金乃至其他复杂材料体系的多目标成分设计提供了新思路。

authors: Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
title: Robustness of RKKY interactions across a Weyl node-annihilation transition
summary: Weyl semimetals (WSMs), with their unique topological properties and distinct electronic structure, exhibit intriguing properties when either time-reversal or inversion symmetries are broken. In this work, we consider the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction between magnetic impurities in time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSMs. We derive analytical expressions for the full RKKY exchange tensor in arbitrary two-band spinful lattice systems. Our approach reveals both Heisenberg, anisotropic Ising and Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya terms, which can be calculated by energy-integrating real-space Green's functions across the entire Brillouin zone, with the band edge acting as a natural energy cutoff. We apply this framework to study a two-band tight-binding model for a time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSM that interpolates between a Weyl phase with well-separated chiral nodes and a quadratic band-touching semimetal phase. Remarkably, the spatial profile, magnitude, and anisotropic tensor structure of the exchange couplings remain persistent across the node-annihilation transition. This topological robustness reveals that short- and intermediate-range RKKY interactions are mediated by the global, Brillouin-zone-integrated quantum metric of the full valence band rather than being strictly dictated by local low-energy Berry curvature monopoles. These findings demonstrate the necessity of full-band tight-binding formulations when predicting real-space magnetic interactions, providing key insights for electric-field tuning of magnetic anisotropy and constructing realistic models of heavy-fermion and Weyl-Kondo semimetals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了时间反演对称性破缺的外尔半金属中磁性杂质间的RKKY相互作用，推导了任意两带自旋晶格系统的完整RKKY交换张量解析表达式，并通过对一个可插值于外尔相和二次能带接触半金属相之间的两带紧束缚模型进行分析，发现交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构在节点湮灭相变中保持鲁棒性，表明短程和中程RKKY相互作用由全价带的布里渊区积分量子度量介导，而非局部低能Berry曲率单极子决定。
AI.motivation: 理解时间反演对称性破缺的外尔半金属中磁性杂质间的RKKY相互作用机制，澄清RKKY交换耦合是否仅由低能Weyl节点的Berry曲率决定，并揭示其拓扑鲁棒性的物理来源。
AI.method: 推导任意两带自旋晶格系统中完整RKKY交换张量的解析表达式（包含Heisenberg、各向异性Ising和Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya项），采用在整个布里渊区对能量积分实空间格林函数的方法，以带边作为自然能量截断；将该框架应用于一个在Weyl相与二次能带接触半金属相之间插值的两带紧束缚模型。
AI.result: 发现交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构在节点湮灭相变中保持不变（拓扑鲁棒性），证明短程和中程RKKY相互作用主要由全价带的布里渊区积分量子度量介导，而非严格由局部低能Berry曲率单极子决定。
AI.conclusion: 预测真实空间磁性相互作用时必须采用全带紧束缚模型，这些发现为通过电场调控磁各向异性以及构建重费米子和Weyl-Kondo半金属的现实模型提供了关键见解。

title: Engineering Giant Thermoelectric Performance through Electrode-Coupling Geometry and Magnetic Flux in Quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Rings
summary: We investigate coherent thermoelectric transport in magnetic-flux-threaded quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) rings with engineered multi-site electrode couplings using the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism within the Landauer-Büttiker framework. We demonstrate that the electrode-coupling geometry serves as a powerful control parameter for tailoring quantum interference, thereby reshaping the transmission spectrum and thermoelectric response. In the absence of magnetic flux, the trivial dimerized phase ($t_1>t_2$) exhibits the highest thermoelectric efficiency, with asymmetric coupling producing a substantially larger figure of merit than the symmetric geometry. Magnetic flux further reconstructs the transmission spectrum through Aharonov-Bohm interference, driving a crossover of the optimal thermoelectric regime from the trivial to the topological dimerized phase. Under optimal flux conditions, the thermoelectric figure of merit reaches $ZT \approx 12$ for symmetric coupling and is dramatically enhanced to $ZT \approx 90$ for asymmetric coupling through enhanced energy filtering and suppressed electronic thermal transport. We further establish a clear correlation between the enhancement of thermoelectric efficiency and the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. Our results demonstrate that the combined interplay of quasiperiodicity, topology, magnetic flux, and electrode-coupling geometry provides a versatile strategy for engineering high-performance coherent thermoelectric devices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用非平衡格林函数和Landauer-Büttiker框架，研究了磁通穿透的准周期SSH环中的相干热电输运。研究发现电极耦合几何构型可作为调控量子干涉的有力参数，在最优磁通条件下，非对称耦合可将热电优值大幅提升至ZT≈90，并建立了热电效率增强与维德曼-弗兰兹定律违背之间的清晰关联。
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过准周期性、拓扑、磁通和电极耦合几何的多重协同作用来工程化设计高性能相干热电装置，特别是寻找超越传统对称几何限制的新调控自由度。
AI.method: 采用非平衡格林函数形式与Landauer-Büttiker框架，对磁通穿透的准周期SSH环进行相干热电输运计算。系统研究了对称与非对称的多位点电极耦合几何，以及不同磁通条件下的热电响应。
AI.result: 1) 无磁通时，平庸二聚化相(t1>t2)展现最高热电效率，非对称耦合优值远大于对称几何；2) 磁通通过Aharonov-Bohm干涉重构透射谱，使最优热电区域从平庸相转变为拓扑二聚化相；3) 对称耦合下ZT≈12，非对称耦合下ZT≈90；4) 热电增强与维德曼-弗兰兹定律违背之间存在清晰相关性。
AI.conclusion: 准周期性、拓扑、磁通和电极耦合几何的协同作用为高性能相干热电装置的设计提供了灵活且通用的策略，其中电极耦合几何被证明是调控热电效率的强有力新控制参数。

title: Diffusion under competing bulk and surface stopping mechanisms
summary: We investigate reflected diffusion in a bounded domain subject to two independent, competing stopping mechanisms: an exponentially distributed bulk lifetime of rate $p$ and a surface reaction triggered when the boundary local time exceeds an independent exponential threshold of rate $q$. Denoting by $T$ the stopping time and by $L$ the acquired boundary local time at stopping, we derive their marginal distributions, joint Laplace transform, and complete hierarchy of mixed moments. These statistics are determined by the splitting probability $φ$ that surface reaction occurs before bulk decay. In particular, we establish the identity $p\expect{T}+q\expect{L}=1$ and show that the cumulative risk $pT+qL$ is exponentially distributed with unit rate. We further obtain equivalent representations of $φ$ in terms of the Robin-Laplacian and the generalized Steklov spectra. Explicit results for a three-dimensional ball reveal how competing rates $p,q$ control $φ$ and the $(T,L)$ statistics. Monte Carlo simulations test the universal cumulative-risk law.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有界区域中受到两种竞争停止机制影响的反射扩散过程：体积寿命（指数速率 p）和边界反应（边界局部时超过独立指数阈值，速率 q）。推导了停止时间 T 和边界局部时 L 的边际分布、联合拉普拉斯变换及混合矩，并建立恒等式 pE[T]+qE[L]=1，表明累积风险 pT+qL 服从单位速率的指数分布。
AI.motivation: 理解竞争停止机制（体积衰减与表面反应）如何共同决定粒子在有界域中的命运，涉及扩散过程中停止时间与边界接触统计的基础理论，对化学反应动力学、统计物理等有重要意义。
AI.method: 利用分裂概率 φ（表面反应先于体积衰减发生的概率）作为关键量，通过 Robin-Laplacian 和广义 Steklov 谱给出其等价表示；结合反射扩散理论和边界局部时的概率结构推导 T 与 L 的统计量；对三维球域进行显式计算并辅以蒙特卡洛模拟验证。
AI.result: 建立了 pE[T]+qE[L]=1 的恒等式，并证明 pT+qL 是单位速率指数分布（普适累积风险定律）。获得了 φ 的谱表示及三维球域中竞争速率 p,q 对 φ 和 (T,L) 统计的显式控制规律，蒙特卡洛模拟验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性体积衰减与表面反应导致的总累积风险 pT+qL 呈现出普适的指数分布特性，不依赖于具体域形状，展示了两种竞争机制间的深刻对偶关系。

title: Electrostatic splitting of an Edge Magnetoplasmon Resonator
comment: Main text 10 pages and 7 figures, supplementary 6 pages and 10 figures
summary: Edge-magnetoplasmon resonators have been proposed as a powerful tool to detect anyons by introducing a quantum point contact into an isolated quantum Hall system probed via radiofrequency radiation. In this paper, we study the effect of a quantum point contact embedded within an edge-magnetoplasmon resonator and how its polarization influences the propagating magnetoplasmonic mode. Combining dc and rf measurements, we unambiguously evidence the signature of both integer ($ν= 1$ and $2$) and fractional quantum Hall states ($ν= 4/3$ and $2/3$) within the radiofrequency transmission signal. Using electrostatic gating, we determine the physical parameters characterizing the electrostatic edge of an AlGaAs/GaAs based two-dimensional electron gas. We extract the dependence of the cavity perimeter with the gate voltage of the quantum point contact and fully characterize the path followed by edge magnetoplasmons in this system. Finally, we provide a geometric model in good agreement with experimental results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了嵌入边缘磁等离激元谐振器中的量子点接触如何影响传播的磁等离激元模式。通过结合直流和射频测量，作者在射频透射信号中明确证实了整数量子霍尔态（ν=1和2）和分数量子霍尔态（ν=4/3和2/3）的特征，并利用静电门控提取了二维电子系统边缘的物理参数，建立了与实验吻合良好的几何模型。
AI.motivation: 边缘磁等离激元谐振器被提出作为探测任意子的有力工具，通过在孤立的量子霍尔系统中引入量子点接触并进行射频探测来实现。理解量子点接触嵌入谐振器后对磁等离激元模式的影响是实现任意子探测的关键前提。
AI.method: 作者采用直流与射频联合测量方法，在嵌入量子点接触的边缘磁等离激元谐振器中检测射频透射信号；利用静电门控技术调节量子点接触的栅极电压，提取限制于AlGaAs/GaAs二维电子气体的静电边缘的物理参数，表征谐振腔周长与栅压的关系，并构建几何模型对实验结果进行解释。
AI.result: 实验明确观测到整数量子霍尔态（ν=1, 2）和分数量子霍尔态（ν=4/3, 2/3）在射频透射信号中的特征；提取了腔周长随量子点接触栅极电压的依赖关系，完全表征了边缘磁等离激元在该系统中的传播路径；所提出的几何模型与实验结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作证实了边缘磁等离激元谐振器能够通过射频信号灵敏地检测多种整数量子霍尔态和分数量子霍尔态，为利用该平台实现任意子探测奠定了实验基础，同时提供了一个可预测的几何模型来理解腔体动力学。

title: Non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes: Exceptional points, Anomalous relaxation, Pseudo-equilibrium and Boundary refrigeration
summary: Non-reciprocal interactions are ubiquitous in active, biological, and disordered systems, generically driving them out of equilibrium. Here, we introduce a hierarchy of non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (NROU) models governed by a tunable non-reciprocity parameter $g$. At a special point $g=g^*$, the drift matrix becomes non-diagonalizable, realizing exceptional points (EP's) of different orders, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors simultaneously coalesce. The hierarchy encompasses non-reciprocally coupled dimers, their disordered counterparts, and a many-body chain exactly mapping onto the paradigmatic Hatano-Nelson model in the arena of non-Hermitian quantum systems. For the disordered model, we show that the distribution of the EP location $g^*$ across disorder realizations develops a universal edge singularity precisely at the clean-system EP, and is manifestly non-self-averaging. Across all models, we find that at the EP, the usual exponential relaxation of the autocorrelation and covariance functions is dressed by a polynomial-in-time prefactor whose degree is set by the order of the EP and whose detailed structure encodes the spatial architecture of the chain. At complete asymmetry, the many-body chain exhibits ``pseudo-equilibrium'': its steady-state distribution factorizes into equilibrium-like single-particle measures despite a nonzero steady-state current. Moreover, the $N$-particle interacting system decomposes into $N/2$ independent complex OU processes. Finally, using the Harada-Sasa relation, we obtain a closed-form expression for the total steady-state heat dissipation and uncover a boundary refrigeration effect, in which the boundary particles switch from acting as a hot to a cold reservoir as the non-reciprocity is tuned.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一类由可调非互易参数g控制的非互易相互作用的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck（NROU）模型层级。在特殊点g=g*处，漂移矩阵变得不可对角化，实现不同阶数的奇异点（EP），特征值和特征向量同时合并。该层级涵盖非互易耦合二聚体、无序对应体以及精确映射到Hatano-Nelson模型的多体链。研究发现无序模型中EP位置分布存在普适边缘奇异性，EP处弛豫函数被多项式时间因子修饰，完全非对称时多体链表现出"赝平衡"，并以闭式形式获得了稳态热耗散，揭示了边界制冷效应。
AI.motivation: 非互易相互作用广泛存在于活性物质、生物系统和无序系统中，普遍驱动系统偏离平衡态。然而，对这些系统中由非互易性导致的奇异点（EP）行为及其动力学后果的系统性理解仍然缺乏，特别是在无序和多体层面的深入研究不足。
AI.method: 引入NROU模型层级，通过非互易参数g统一刻画不同系统（二聚体、无序系统、多体链）。利用非厄米量子系统中Hatano-Nelson模型的精确映射，分析EP处特征值和特征向量同时合并的行为。通过解析计算自相关函数、协方差函数的弛豫行为，并使用Harada-Sasa关系推导稳态热耗散。
AI.result: 发现无序模型中EP位置的分布存在普适边缘奇异性且非自平均；EP处指数弛豫被多项式时间因子修饰，度数由EP阶数决定并编码链的空间结构；完全非对称时多体链呈现"赝平衡"稳态；N粒子系统分解为N/2个独立复OU过程；获得总稳态热耗散的闭式表达式，发现边界粒子可作为冷热源随非互易性切换的边界制冷效应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了非互易OU过程与非厄米量子系统之间的深层联系，揭示了EP处普适的动力学奇异行为和非自平均现象，并展示了非互易性如何调节热力学性质（如边界制冷效应），为理解非平衡系统中的奇异点物理提供了统一框架。

title: Local coordination, structural softening, and polarization-switching energetics in Sc-alloyed GaN
summary: Sc-alloyed wurtzite nitrides exhibit strongly tunable electromechanical and ferroelectric properties, yet the relationship between their lattice evolution and local bonding environment remains insufficiently established, particularly in Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N. Here, we investigate the structural and local bonding evolution of Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N across the dilute-to-intermediate composition range by combining X-ray diffraction, Sc K-edge X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES), extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) and first-principles calculations. Sc incorporation produces an anisotropic lattice expansion and a progressive reduction in the c/a ratio. XANES and EXAFS reveal a concurrent modification of the local environment around Sc, with the effective Sc-N coordination number increasing from 4.1(4) to 4.5(2) and the average Sc-N bond length increasing from 2.045(7) to 2.081(8)Å over x=0.06-0.26. The local response is accompanied by a reduction in the Sc K-edge pre-edge intensity, consistent with a gradual reduction of the local tetrahedral asymmetry. First-principles calculations show that these structural changes are associated with site-selective distortions around Sc and progressive flattening of the structural energy landscape. The calculated intrinsic polarization-switching barrier decreases from 24.2 to 19.0 meV/Å$^3$ with increasing Sc content, while the calculated piezoelectric stress coefficient (e$_{33}$) increases from 0.82 to 1.66~C/m$^2$ and elastic constant (C$_{33}$) decreases from 380 to 227~GPa, resulting in an increase of piezoelectric strain coefficient (d$_{33}$) from 2.99 to 12.46~pC/N. These results show that Sc incorporation progressively modifies the local coordination environment and structural energetics of ScGaN while the long-range wurtzite structure remains preserved over the investigated composition range.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过X射线衍射、XANES、EXAFS及第一性原理计算，系统揭示了Sc_xGa_1-xN在稀释到中等组分范围内（x=0.06-0.26）的结构与局域键合演化，发现Sc掺入导致各向异性晶格膨胀、c/a比降低、Sc-N配位数从4.1增至4.5、键长从2.045增至2.081Å，同时压电极化切换势垒降低、压电系数(d33)从2.99增至12.46 pC/N，而长程纤锌矿结构保持完整。
AI.motivation: Sc合金化纤锌矿氮化物具有高度可调的机电和铁电性能，但晶格演化与局域键合环境之间的关系尚未被充分建立，特别是Sc_xGa_1-xN体系中这一关系的理解仍欠缺。
AI.method: 结合同步辐射X射线衍射、Sc K-edge XANES、EXAFS光谱手段与第一性原理计算，对稀释到中等Sc组分范围的Sc_xGa_1-xN进行结构与局域环境的系统表征。
AI.result: Sc掺入引起各向异性晶格膨胀和c/a比渐进降低；Sc-N有效配位数从4.1(4)增至4.5(2)，平均键长从2.045(7)增至2.081(8)Å；预边峰强度降低表明局域四面体不对称性减弱；极化切换势垒从24.2降至19.0 meV/Å³，e33从0.82增至1.66 C/m²，C33从380降至227 GPa，d33从2.99增至12.46 pC/N。
AI.conclusion: Sc掺入逐步改变ScGaN的局域配位环境和结构能量学，同时在所研究的组分范围内长程纤锌矿结构得以保持，建立了局域键合变化与宏观压电性能提升之间的关联。

title: Influence of dislocation density on the tribological response in oxides: case study on SrTiO3
summary: Most ceramics suffer from brittle surface damage and cracking when small particles slide across the surface under low load. Microscratching tests are a useful technique to mimic this loading scenario while retaining the material's deformation history; however, the impact of pre-seeded dislocations, which can significantly facilitate plastic deformation, has not been explored in ceramics. Here, the influence of mechanically seeded dislocations on the microscratching response of oxides is investigated using a model perovskite, SrTiO3. First, various dislocation densities over four orders of magnitude are introduced via room-temperature cyclic Brinell indenter scratching. Subsequently, load-ramped microscratching tests are performed within the pristine and dislocation-seeded regions using a nominally 30 μm spherical diamond tip. On the reference pristine surface, we observe a clear transition from elastic to elasto-plastic deformation, followed by median/radial cracking at higher loads. In contrast, pre-seeded dislocations, accompanied by residual compressive stresses, suppress elastic deformation and lead to median/radial crack shortening and subsequent transition to a partial cone crack. The subsurface cracks are characterized by 3D Nano-CT. The changes in crack geometry, with and without dislocations, were described using the Lawn-Evans-Marshall and Lawn-Wiederhorn-Roberts models. These findings provide direct evidence of dislocation-regulated near-surface damage tolerance, with general applicability to other plastically deformable oxides.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了预置位错对陶瓷材料（以SrTiO3为模型）微划痕响应的影响，发现位错结合残余压应力可抑制弹性变形、缩短裂纹并改变裂纹几何形态，提供了位错调控近表面损伤容限的直接证据。
AI.motivation: 陶瓷材料在低载荷下小颗粒滑动时易发生脆性表面损伤和开裂。微划痕测试虽能模拟此场景，但预置位错对陶瓷微划痕行为的影响此前从未被探究过，而这可能显著促进塑性变形。
AI.method: 首先通过室温循环布氏压头划痕在SrTiO3中引入跨越四个数量级的位错密度；随后使用30μm球形金刚石尖在原始区域和位错种子区域进行载荷递增的微划痕测试；并通过3D纳米CT表征亚表面裂纹，最后用Lawn-Evans-Marshall和Lawn-Wiederhorn-Roberts模型描述裂纹几何变化。
AI.result: 原始表面表现出从弹性到弹塑性变形的清晰转变，随后在较高载荷下出现中/径向裂纹；而预置位错伴随残余压应力抑制了弹性变形，导致中/径向裂纹缩短并转变为部分锥形裂纹。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为位错调控近表面损伤容限提供了直接证据，且该方法可推广到其他可塑性变形的氧化物材料。

title: Variable Charge State, Magnetic Excitations, and Kondo Effect of Sm/g/Ir(111)
summary: Using low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy we investigate the charge state, magnetic excitations, and Kondo features of individual Sm adatoms on graphene/Ir(111). Depending on the number and distance of their neighbors, Sm atoms can be in two discrete charge states. At certain distances, a reversible transition between these two states is induced by the electric field of the STM tip leading to concentric charge rings in the images. Only atoms in one of the two charge states exhibit magnetic excitations in d$I$/d$V$ spectra. Two such excitations are located at 35~meV and 54~meV and related to transitions from the $J = 1/2$ ground state doublet to the first crystal field split $J = 3/2$ multiplet. Together with the intra-atomic exchange excitations at higher energy, these observations indicate that Sm transfers one $6s$ electron to the substrate while it retains its gas-phase $4f$ filling. New for lanthanide adatoms, we observe a Kondo resonance. The Zeeman splitting of the Kondo peak reveals that Sm retains its large gas-phase $g$-factor. Comparison of d$I$/d$V$ spectra to cotunneling theory yields the crystal field acting on the $4f$ shell and, consequently, on the $J = 3/2$ quadruplet, confirms Sm$^+$ as the ground state, and identifies Sm$^{2+}$ as being energetically close, thereby rationalizing our observation of variable charge states.

AI.tldr: 本文利用低温扫描隧道显微镜研究了石墨烯/Ir(111)基底上单个Sm原子的电荷态、磁激发和近藤特征。研究发现Sm原子可处于两种离散电荷态，可在STM针尖电场下可逆转变。仅一种电荷态表现出磁激发（35和54 meV处），对应J=1/2基态双重态到晶体场劈裂的J=3/2多重态的跃迁。首次在镧系吸附原子上观察到近藤共振，Zeeman劈裂表明Sm保留其气相g因子。与共隧穿理论的对比确定了作用于4f壳层的晶体场，确认Sm+为基态，Sm2+能量上接近，从而解释了可变电荷态的观察。
AI.motivation: 理解单个镧系原子在表面上的电荷态、磁性和关联电子行为，特别是Sm这类具有强自旋-轨道耦合与复杂4f电子结构的原子与底物的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 采用低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合dI/dV谱学，研究单原子Sm吸附于石墨烯/Ir(111)表面上的电子性质。通过STM针尖电场诱导电荷态可逆转变，结合dI/dV谱分析磁激发能量与Zeeman劈裂，并与共隧穿（cotunneling）理论对比来确定晶体场参数与电子构型。
AI.result: 发现Sm原子可处于两种离散电荷态且可在STM针尖电场下可逆转换形成同心电荷环；仅一种电荷态的Sm展现磁激发（35和54 meV处，对应J=1/2到J=3/2跃迁）；首次在镧系单原子吸附体系观察到近藤共振；Zeeman分裂显示Sm保留气相g因子；理论对比确认Sm+为基态，Sm2+能量接近。
AI.conclusion: Sm在石墨烯/Ir(111)上转移一个6s电子给基底（形成Sm+），同时保持气相4f填充。Sm+为基态而Sm2+能量上非常接近，这使得两种电荷态能够共存并可逆切换。首次观察到的镧系吸附原子近藤共振以及晶体场的精确确定，为理解镧系单原子体系的量子磁性提供了新的平台与见解。

title: Generalized Helicity-Dependent Magnetization Switching via Substrate Phonons
summary: Coherent excitation of circularly-polarized substrate phonons can drive deterministic reversal of magnetization in an adjacent magnetic layer. However, the extent to which this substrate-mediated mechanism can be generalized across different materials remains unresolved. Here, we measure and compare the spectral dependence of helicity-dependent magnetization reversal in magnetic GdFeCo layers grown on a diverse set of diamagnetic substrates. Switching is observed for all investigated substrates, spanning six point groups and several infrared-active transverse-optical phonon symmetries. While the switching spectra broadly overlap with the Reststrahlen bands, their maxima are systematically shifted to wavelengths shorter than the corresponding transverse-optical phonon resonances. This spectral mismatch shows that substrate absorption alone does not determine the switching efficiency. Transfer-matrix calculations show that strong absorption concentrates energy deposition near the substrate interface, providing a possible source of local heating that could suppress magnetization reversal. Our results reveal the broad applicability of substrate-mediated phononic switching while showing that its efficiency is governed by the full optical response of the heterostructure rather than substrate absorption alone.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统探究了通过圆偏振基底声子激发实现相邻磁性层磁化反转的普适性。作者在多种不同对称性和声子模式的抗磁基底上生长GdFeCo磁性层，发现所有基底均能实现开关，但开关光谱与Reststrahlen带存在系统性偏移（峰值偏向更短波长），表明基底吸收本身并非决定开关效率的唯一因素。转移矩阵计算揭示强吸收会将能量沉积集中在界面附近，可能因局部加热抑制反转。该工作证明基底介导的声子开关具有广泛适用性，但其效率由整个异质结构的光学响应决定。
AI.motivation: 此前已证明圆偏振基底声子激发可驱动相邻磁性层产生确定性磁化反转，但该基底介导机制能否推广至不同材料体系尚不清楚。作者希望验证这一机制的普适性，并厘清其效率究竟是受基底吸收主导还是受整个异质结构光学响应控制。
AI.method: 在跨越六个点群、多种红外活性横光学声子对称性的抗磁基底上制备GdFeCo磁性层，对比测量螺旋度依赖的磁化反转光谱；并结合转移矩阵计算分析异质结构中能量沉积的空间分布及其对反转效率的影响。
AI.result: 所有被研究的基底均观察到磁化反转，表明该机制具有广泛适用性；但反转光谱峰值与相应TO声子共振相比系统性蓝移（向短波长偏移），与Reststrahlen带仅宽泛重叠。转移矩阵计算表明，基底强吸收会将能量集中在界面附近，引发局部加热从而可能抑制反转。
AI.conclusion: 基底介导的声子磁化开关是一种普适现象，适用于多种基底材料；然而其效率并非仅由基底吸收决定，而是受整个异质结构的完整光学响应（包括能量沉积的空间分布）共同调控，这对优化此类异质结构的器件设计具有重要意义。

title: A locally ab initio computational framework for arbitrary incommensurate materials interfaces
summary: Incommensurate materials interfaces constitute a broad and technologically important class of systems, yet their lack of shared periodicity limits predictive and computationally efficient first-principles electronic-structure methods. Here we introduce a scalable computational framework for constructing locally ab initio electronic Hamiltonians for arbitrary materials interfaces. Our approach exploits the nearsightedness of Wannier Hamiltonian matrix elements, enabling their systematic extrapolation and interpolation across interlayer registries. This strategy yields transferable Hamiltonians that retain first-principles accuracy while bypassing the need for prohibitively large commensurate supercells or Moiré approximations. We validate the framework on quasicrystalline 30° twisted bilayer graphene, reproducing experimentally observed spectral features including mirrored Dirac cones and minigaps at avoided crossings arising from generalized interlayer scattering. We further predict quasiperiodic flat-band states in experimentally accessible doping regimes. By enabling predictive electronic-structure calculations across structurally incommensurate interfaces, this framework establishes a practical route to first-principles exploration of emergent interfacial phenomena.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的计算框架，利用Wannier哈密顿矩阵元的近程性（nearsightedness），为任意非公度材料界面构建局域从头算电子哈密顿量，避免了对庞大的公度超胞或Moiré近似的需求。
AI.motivation: 非公度材料界面广泛存在且具有重要的技术意义，但由于缺乏共享周期性，限制了对其高效、可预测的第一性原理电子结构计算方法的开发。传统的公度超胞方法计算成本过高，而Moiré近似又不够精确。
AI.method: 该框架利用Wannier哈密顿矩阵元的近程性原理，实现对不同层间堆叠位形（interlayer registries）上矩阵元的系统性外推与插值，从而构建可迁移的局部从头算电子哈密顿量。该方法绕过了需要巨大公度超胞的限制。
AI.result: 在准晶30°扭转双层石墨烯上验证了该框架的有效性，成功复现了实验观测的光谱特征，包括镜像狄拉克锥和由广义层间散射引起的反交叉处迷你带隙。此外还预测了在实验可及的掺杂范围内存在准周期平带态。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为跨结构非公度界面的预测性电子结构计算开辟了实用途径，为第一性原理探索新兴界面现象提供了可行路线。

title: Cross-Layer Anomalous Hall Transport driven by Néel-Vector rotating in the Altermagnet candidate V2Te2O
summary: In van der Waals (vdW) materials, weak interlayer coupling generally suppresses vertical dispersion, reinforcing the conventional paradigm that in-plane transport dominates over cross-layer channels. Here, using first-principles calculations and magnetic symmetry analyses, we uncover a giant, symmetry-unlocked cross-layer anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in the vdW altermagnet V2Te2O. In the magnetic ground state with Neel vector N//z, horizontal mirror symmetry protects a spin-polarized nodal chain near the Fermi level and strictly enforces zero anomalous Hall response. Tilting the Neel vector explicitly breaks this mirror protection, allowing spin-orbit coupling to gap the nodal chain and activate a sharp cross-layer Hall response. When the Neel vector is rotated into the in-plane configuration (N//x), cross-layer orbital hybridization generates intensive Berry curvature hotspots, boosting the cross-layer component of AHC σ_{yz} to approximately 255 S/cm, which exceeds in-plane component σ_{xy} by nearly two orders of magnitude. Furthermore, varying the azimuthal angle systematically redistributes the anomalous Hall response, enabling full directional control of transverse transport. Our findings demonstrate a highly sensitive cross-layer anomalous Hall switch activated by low-barrier spin canting, offering promising avenues for directional tensor selection and low-power multi-axial vdW spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和磁性对称性分析，在vdW交替磁体V2Te2O中发现了巨大的对称性解锁的跨层反常霍尔电导（AHC）。当Néel矢量从垂直方向倾斜到面内方向时，跨层AHC分量σ_yz可达约255 S/cm，比面内分量σ_xy高出约两个数量级，实现了低势垒自旋倾斜控制的高灵敏跨层反常霍尔开关。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为vdW材料中弱的层间耦合会抑制垂直方向色散，导致面内输运主导而跨层输运通道被忽视。作者希望打破这一范式，探索vdW材料中是否存在巨大的跨层反常霍尔输运，并研究其对称性起源和控制机制。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算和磁性对称性分析，研究vdW交替磁体V2Te2O中的电子结构和反常霍尔效应。通过分析Néel矢量方向（N//z和N//x）对镜面对称性的影响，以及自旋轨道耦合对节点链的能隙打开作用，系统性地计算并调控跨层与面内AHC分量。
AI.result: 在N//z的磁基态中，水平镜面对称性保护自旋极化节点链并严格抑制反常霍尔响应；当Néel矢量旋转至面内N//x时，跨层轨道杂化产生强Berry曲率热点，使跨层AHC σ_yz达到约255 S/cm，超出面内分量σ_xy近两个数量级；改变方位角可系统性地重新分配反常霍尔响应，实现横向输运的全方向控制。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现了一个由低势垒自旋倾斜激活的高灵敏跨层反常霍尔开关，展示了vdW交替磁体中跨层输运的巨大潜力，为方向性张量选择和多轴低功耗vdW自旋电子学器件提供了新途径。

title: Anharmonic Lattice Dynamics and Anisotropic Electron-Phonon Coupling in Quasi-1-Dimensional Charge Density Wave Ta2NiSe7
summary: The microscopic origin of charge density wave formation in quasi one dimensional Ta2NiSe7 remains actively debated, particularly regarding the relative contributions of Fermi surface nesting, electron phonon coupling, and lattice instabilities. Here, we combine temperature and orientation dependent polarized Raman spectroscopy with first principles calculations to uncover the anisotropic electronic and lattice interactions governing the CDW state in Ta2NiSe7. Heat capacity and electrical transport measurements identify an incommensurate CDW transition at 61 K. Raman spectroscopy reveals pronounced in plane anisotropy, with e ph coupling strength along intrachain b axis exceeding five times that along interchain c axis, whereas lattice anharmonicity is enhanced by threefold along c axis. First principles calculations identify Ta2 Se octahedral vibrations and Ta Se electronic states near the Fermi level as dominant channels mediating the anisotropic e ph interaction. Exceptionally strong and directional e ph coupling along b axis establishes lattice driven electronic instability as the primary mechanism underlying CDW modulation and highlights the dominance of intrachain interactions in strongly coupled Ta2NiSe7. Despite this strong coupling, the CDW remains incommensurate, indicating that lattice anharmonicity provides an additional degree of freedom. Enhanced anharmonicity along c axis suggests that anisotropic phonon phonon interactions reshape the free energy landscape and contribute to stabilizing incommensurate phase. These findings reveal a cooperative interplay between anisotropic e ph coupling and lattice anharmonicity in governing CDW formation in low dimensional quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文结合变温和变偏振的拉曼光谱与第一性原理计算，研究了准一维材料Ta2NiSe7中电荷密度波（CDW）的形成机制。研究发现沿b轴（链内）的电子-声子耦合强度是沿c轴（链间）的五倍以上，而沿c轴的晶格非谐性增强了三倍。第一性原理计算确定Ta2Se八面体振动和费米能级附近的Ta-Se电子态是介导各向异性电-声耦合的主要通道。强且定向的b轴电-声耦合确立了晶格驱动的电子不稳定性是CDW调制的主要机制，而沿c轴增强的非谐性有助于稳定非公度相，揭示了各向异性电-声耦合与晶格非谐性之间的协同作用。
AI.motivation: 准一维材料Ta2NiSe7中电荷密度波形成的微观起源仍存在激烈争论，特别是费米面嵌套、电子-声子耦合和晶格不稳定性各自贡献的相对大小不明确，因此需要系统地探究其各向异性电子和晶格相互作用。
AI.method: 实验上采用温度和取向依赖的偏振拉曼光谱；物理性质方面结合热容和电输运测量；理论上利用第一性原理计算，综合分析各向异性的电-声耦合和晶格非谐性对CDW态的贡献。
AI.result: 发现61 K处存在非公度CDW跃迁；b轴电-声耦合强度为c轴的五倍以上，而c轴晶格非谐性为b轴的三倍；第一性原理计算识别出Ta2Se八面体振动和费米能级附近Ta-Se电子态是主导各向异性电-声耦合的通道。
AI.conclusion: b轴强且定向的电-声耦合确立了晶格驱动的电子不稳定性是CDW调制的首要机制，突出了链内相互作用在强耦合Ta2NiSe7中的主导地位；沿c轴增强的晶格非谐性重塑自由能景观，有助于稳定非公度相，表明CDW形成是由各向异性电-声耦合与晶格非谐性协同调控的。

title: Semiclassical thermoelectric transport in disordered Dirac electron system Ag2Te
summary: We investigated the thermoelectric effects of the Dirac electron system Ag2Te under magnetic field. Our anal-ysis based on the Boltzmann semiclassical model associated the disorder with the unconventional magnetic field responses such as linear magnetoresistance, linear Nernst effect, step-like Nernst effect, and sign change in Nernst effect. The analysis also revealed the impurity band near the Fermi energy. We simultaneously clari-fied the serious impact of the thermal Hall effect on the measurement of the Nernst effect, and we proposed the definitive solution. Our careful measurement and analysis will be the standard for the thermoelectric study under magnetic field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了磁场下Dirac电子系统Ag2Te的热电效应，基于Boltzmann半经典模型将无序与非常规磁场响应（线性磁阻、线性Nernst效应、阶梯状Nernst效应和Nernst效应符号变化）联系起来，揭示了费米能附近的杂质带，同时阐明了热霍尔效应对Nernst效应测量的严重影响并提出了解决方案。
AI.motivation: 研究Dirac电子系统Ag2Te在磁场下的热电效应，理解无序如何导致非常规的磁场响应现象，并解决Nernst效应测量中热霍尔效应干扰的问题。
AI.method: 基于Boltzmann半经典模型的实验测量与理论分析，关联无序与磁场下的非常规响应，同时分析热霍尔效应对Nernst测量的影响并提出解决方案。
AI.result: 成功解释了线性磁阻、线性Nernst效应、阶梯状Nernst效应及Nernst效应符号变化等现象，揭示了费米能附近的杂质带，并明确了热霍尔效应对Nernst测量的严重干扰及解决途径。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为磁场下热电测量提供了标准方法，careful的测量与分析可作为该领域的参考标杆。

title: Interfacial Accommodation as a Candidate Ductility Pathway in Intermetallic-Rich Alloys
summary: Heterophase interfaces are increasingly recognized as active participants in plastic deformation, yet quantitative methods for comparing their strain-accommodation capacity remain limited. Here, we present an atomistic framework for quantifying interface-mediated strain accommodation using molecular dynamics simulations. Interface broadening, roughening, and migration are extracted from atomistic trajectories and combined into an Interface Accommodation Index, with a normalized counterpart accounting for differences in initial interface structure. A weighting sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the relative ranking of interfaces is robust to the specific form of the index. The framework is demonstrated for three experimentally motivated interfaces, Al/Al3Ti, Al/Al9M2, and Al9M2/Al3Ti (M = Fe, Co, Ni), under tensile, compressive, and shear loading. Bulk simulations show that Shockley partial dislocations dominate plastic deformation, with alloy chemistry governing the transition toward mixed-character dislocation networks. Tensile loading produces the greatest interface accommodation, while shear produces comparatively limited structural evolution. The Al9M2/Al3Ti interface exhibits both the highest yield resistance and the largest accommodation response, suggesting that intermetallic-intermetallic interfaces can simultaneously sustain load and redistribute strain. These simulations quantify structural accommodation rather than ductility or fracture directly; their connection to macroscopic ductility therefore requires experimental validation. The framework provides a transferable approach for comparing interface accommodation in multiphase alloys and identifies interface chemistry and crystallography as important design variables for damage-tolerant structural materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于分子动力学模拟的原子级框架，用于量化异相界面介导的应变容纳能力。该框架从原子轨迹中提取界面拓宽、粗糙化和迁移特征，组合成"界面容纳指数"(Interface Accommodation Index)及其归一化版本。通过在三种实验动机界面(Al/Al3Ti、Al/Al9M2、Al9M2/Al3Ti)上的张力、压缩和剪切加载演示，发现Al9M2/Al3Ti界面同时具有最高屈服抗力和最大容纳响应，表明金属间化合物之间的界面能同时承载载荷和再分配应变。
AI.motivation: 异相界面越来越多地被认识到是塑性变形中的活跃参与者，但目前缺乏定量方法来比较不同界面的应变容纳能力，这限制了多相合金中界面设计对损伤容限性能的优化。
AI.method: 利用分子动力学模拟，从原子轨迹中提取界面拓宽、粗糙化和迁移三种特征，组合成Interface Accommodation Index及其归一化版本（修正初始界面结构差异），并通过权重敏感性分析验证排序稳健性。框架在三种界面和三种加载条件下进行系统演示。
AI.result: 块体模拟显示Shockley部分位错主导塑性变形，合金化学成分控制向混合特征位错网络的转变。拉伸加载产生最大的界面容纳，而剪切加载产生相对有限的结构演化。Al9M2/Al3Ti界面表现出最高的屈服抗力和最大的容纳响应。权重敏感性分析表明界面相对排序对指数具体形式具有稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多相合金中界面容纳比较提供了可迁移的方法，识别了界面化学和晶体学作为损伤容忍结构材料的重要设计变量。研究强调模拟量化的是结构容纳而非延展性或断裂，与宏观延展性的关联需要实验验证。

title: Neural-field design of broadband Rayleigh-wave carpet cloaks under microstructure realisability constraints
summary: Transformation elasticity provides appropriate material distributions for elastodynamic cloaks but the required stiffness tensors generally violate the minor symmetries of Cauchy elasticity and are difficult to realise using conventional materials. Existing approaches restore these symmetries by modifying the transformed tensor, producing only an approximate cloak. In this work rather than modifying the transformed tensor we seek the best performing cloak within the class of Cauchy materials. We formulate 2D Rayleigh wave carpet cloak design as an optimisation problem governed by partial differential equations. Using a coordinate based neural-field and a differentiable finite element model solver we optimise symmetric stiffness and density fields by minimising wave field distortion. Both single frequency and broadband optimisation are considered, with the broadband model trained over multiple frequencies. Physical realisability is addressed using a database of homogenised microstructures through conditional diffusion, neural-field inverse design, and nearest-neighbour selection. FEM simulations show that the optimised Cauchy design approaches the ideal transformation-based cloak. After projection onto explicit microstructures, the homogenised representation recovers approximately 97% of the defect free reference surface-displacement magnitude, while direct FEM simulation of the fully resolved microstructured geometry recovers approximately 76%

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于偏微分方程约束优化和神经场/可微有限元求解器的二维瑞利波地毯隐身衣设计方法，在Cauchy材料类别内直接优化对称刚度和密度场，无需修改变换张量，从而逼近理想变换隐身效果。通过条件扩散、神经场逆设计和最近邻选择实现物理可制造性，FEM仿真表明优化后的Cauchy设计接近理想变换隐身衣，投影到显式微结构后均质化表示恢复约97%的无缺陷参考表面位移幅度，完全分辨微结构几何的直接FEM仿真恢复约76%。
AI.motivation: 变换弹性所需的刚度张量通常违反Cauchy弹性的次要对称性，难以用常规材料实现。现有方法通过修改变换张量恢复对称性，但只能产生近似隐身效果。作者希望在Cauchy材料类内直接寻找最优隐身衣性能，而非妥协于修改后的张量。
AI.method: 将二维瑞利波地毯隐身衣设计表述为由偏微分方程约束的优化问题。采用基于坐标的神经场与可微有限元模型求解器，通过最小化波场畸变来优化对称刚度和密度场。考虑单频和宽带优化，宽带模型在多个频率上训练。物理可实现性通过均质化微结构数据库实现，包括条件扩散、神经场逆设计和最近邻选择多阶段策略。
AI.result: FEM仿真表明，优化后的Cauchy设计性能接近理想变换隐身衣。投影到显式微结构后，均质化表示可恢复约97%的无缺陷参考表面位移幅度，而完全分辨微结构几何的直接FEM仿真恢复约76%。
AI.conclusion: 在不修改变换张量的前提下，通过基于神经场和可微FEM的优化方法可以在Cauchy材料类别内实现接近理想的变换隐身性能，结合微结构数据库可实现从理论设计到物理可制造结构的全流程转换，尽管完全分辨微结构后存在一定性能折损。

title: Remote epitaxy beyond polarity
summary: Remote epitaxy through a monolayer two-dimensional material-covered substrate establishes a crystallographic registry across the van der Waals (vdW) surface that enables the epitaxial growth, lift-off and transfer of single-crystalline films. A central belief in remote epitaxy is that the substrate facilitating the phenomenon must be a material with strong ionicity, as the interatomic electrostatic potential fluctuation in covalent and metallic materials is substantially attenuated by two-dimensional materials. Here, we show remote epitaxy is possible when the substrate is a metallic or covalently bonded material and experimentally demonstrate non-polar remote homo- and heteroepitaxy across a wide range of material systems, including both metals and semiconductors. The achieved non-polar remote interactions are designed and engineered by harnessing substrate conductivity and vicinal surface step-edge density. These findings indicate that remote epitaxy is universal and applicable to ionic, metallic, and covalent materials, expanding its capabilities and stimulating a plethora of new fundamental scientific questions about the mechanism of remote epitaxy.

AI.tldr: 本文证明远程外延不仅在离子性材料基底上可行，在金属和共价键材料基底上同样可行，通过利用基底导电性和邻晶面台阶密度实现了非极性远程同质/异质外延，说明远程外延具有普适性。
AI.motivation: 此前远程外延的核心假设认为基底必须是强离子性材料，因为金属和共价材料的原子间静电势波动会被二维材料显著衰减。作者希望挑战这一传统认知，探索远程外延在更广泛材料体系中的可能性。
AI.method: 作者通过工程化设计基底导电性和邻晶面台阶边缘密度，在金属和共价键材料基底上实现了非极性远程同质外延和异质外延，涉及金属和半导体等多种材料体系。
AI.result: 实验成功演示了在金属和共价材料基底上的非极性远程外延，覆盖了广泛材料体系（包括金属和半导体），推翻了此前对基底离子性强制的认知。
AI.conclusion: 远程外延具有普适性，适用于离子性、金属性和共价性材料，极大扩展了远程外延的应用能力，并为远程外延机理研究提出了新的基础科学问题。

title: Customized spin spirals in ferromagnetic thin films
summary: The advancement of spintronic nanoscale devices hinges on the ability to flexibly engineer magnetic spin structures in thin-film stacks with precision and control. Meeting this demand remains a challenge for stable non-collinear spin configurations and, more specifically, vertical spin spirals in thin films. Innovative methods are required for their fabrication, stabilization and control. Here, we use oblique-incidence deposition to design and stabilize vertical spin spirals at room temperature and without an external field in magnetic thin films. We induce two crossed uniaxial magnetic anisotropies at the thin film boundaries. These anisotropies are tunable in direction and strength, thus providing control over the angular range and depth profile of the resulting spin spiral. The combination of polarized neutron reflectometry and nuclear resonant scattering enables precise and direct determination of the depth-dependent spin configurations. Our results establish a single-film design approach, in which the surface anisotropies independently serve as controllable design parameters for tailoring the vertical spin-spiral profile. Potential applications include nanoscale energy-storage devices, magnetic sensors, and ferromagnetic-resonance filters, advancing all-spin-based device engineering in general.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过斜角沉积（oblique-incidence deposition）在磁性薄膜中设计并稳定垂直自旋螺旋的新方法，该方法可在室温且无需外磁场条件下实现。通过在薄膜边界诱导两个交叉的单轴磁各向异性，实现了对自旋螺旋角度范围和深度分布的可控调节，并利用偏振中子反射和核共振散射精确表征自旋构型。
AI.motivation: 自旋电子纳米器件的发展需要对薄膜堆叠中的磁性自旋结构进行灵活且精确的工程调控。然而，稳定的非共线自旋构型，特别是薄膜中的垂直自旋螺旋，其制备、稳定和控制仍是挑战，需要创新的方法来解决。
AI.method: 采用斜角沉积技术在磁性薄膜边界诱导两个交叉的单轴磁各向异性（可调方向和强度），从而在室温无外场条件下设计并稳定垂直自旋螺旋。利用偏振中子反射（PNR）与核共振散射（NRS）相结合的手段精确测定深度依赖的自旋构型。
AI.result: 成功实现了室温无外场条件下磁性薄膜中垂直自旋螺旋的稳定化，各向异性的方向与强度可调，可控制自旋螺旋的角度范围和深度剖面，并通过PNR和NRS精确确定了深度依赖的自旋构型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了单薄膜设计方法，表面各向异性可作为独立可控的设计参数来定制垂直自旋螺旋剖面。潜在应用涵盖纳米级储能器件、磁性传感器和铁磁共振滤波器，推动全自旋器件工程的发展。

title: From Electronic Structure to Environmental Remediation: Adsorption of Ionized Glyphosate on COOH-Modified Carbon Nanotube
summary: Glyphosate is a widely used herbicide whose persistence and toxicity in aquatic and terrestrial environments demand efficient removal strategies. Here we employ GFN2 xTB calculations with implicit ALPB aqueous solvation and automated docking to investigate the adsorption of all five pH dependent ionized forms of glyphosate (G1-G5) on (10,0) single walled carbon nanotubes covalently functionalized with carboxyl groups at 0-25% coverage. Adsorption energies reveal a clear charge dependent trend: the dianionic (G4) and trianionic (G5) species exhibit the most negative binding energies over the entire functionalization range, while the protonated and neutral forms (G1, G2) bind weakly, approaching reversible adsorption at high COOH contents. The deprotonated form G5 strengthens from -2.17 eV on pristine CNT to about -5.7 eV at 10% and 25% functionalization, with a local minimum near 15-20% COOH due to steric and electrostatic crowding of adjacent groups. Decomposition of the solvation free energy shows dominant electrostatic stabilization complemented by increasingly favorable hydrogen bond contributions as carboxyl density grows. All complexes display very small HOMO-LUMO gaps (0.02-0.22 eV), indicating high electronic sensitivity to adsorption and functionalization. Overall, CNT+COOH systems can operate in both strong capture and regenerable regimes depending on glyphosate ionization state, offering a tunable platform for pH responsive remediation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过GFN2 xTB计算与ALPB隐式水溶剂模型及自动对接方法，系统考察了草甘膦五种pH依赖离子形态（G1-G5）在羧基功能化（0-25%覆盖率）（10,0）单壁碳纳米管上的吸附行为，揭示了显著的电荷依赖性吸附趋势，并提出该材料可作为pH响应型可调吸附平台用于草甘膦污染修复。
AI.motivation: 草甘膦作为广泛使用的除草剂，在水生和陆地环境中的持久性与毒性要求开发高效的去除策略，因此需要深入理解其在功能化碳纳米管上的吸附机理以指导污染修复材料设计。
AI.method: 采用GFN2 xTB量子化学计算结合ALPB隐式水溶剂化处理，并辅以自动化分子对接技术，系统地计算了草甘膦五种离子形态在羧基功能化（覆盖率0-25%）单壁碳纳米管上的吸附能及溶剂化自由能分解。
AI.result: 吸附能呈现清晰的电荷依赖趋势：双阴离子（G4）与三阴离子（G5）形态结合能最负，且G5从原始CNT上的-2.17 eV增强至10%和25%功能化时的约-5.7 eV；高COOH含量下质子化/中性形态趋于可逆吸附。溶剂化自由能分解显示静电稳定化为主导，羧基密度增加使氢键贡献增强。所有复合物HOMO-LUMO能隙极小（0.02-0.22 eV），表明对吸附与功能化具有高电子敏感性。
AI.conclusion: CNT+COOH体系可根据草甘膦离子化状态在强捕获与可再生两种模式间切换，为pH响应型污染修复提供了可调控平台，且其小能隙特性有望用于传感检测应用。
